evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DSH MCP Server

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes a **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** server from the
running Harness host, so other agent harnesses — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, another DSH, any MCP
client — can call DSH: start sessions, drive turns, wait for them, read transcripts, and cancel work.

The plugin is a Host-only bundle with **zero dependencies** (no DSH import, no third-party module),
so it installs into a profile and survives Harness upgrades that keep the service contracts.
Every request is attributed to the calling agent and every session is recorded against its creator,
so several harnesses can share one endpoint and still ask "which sessions are mine?".

```
other harness ──MCP (Streamable HTTP or stdio)──> DSH MCP Server ──> DSH services
                                                                     sessionController / sessionQuery / tools
```

## What it exposes

| MCP tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `dsh_run_prompt` | Start a **new** DSH session and run one prompt; returns the assistant's final text and the new `sessionId`. Supports `cwd`, `agentPreset`, `permissionPreset`, `model` (`provider/model`), `wait: false`, `timeoutMs`. |
| `dsh_continue_session` | Send a prompt to an **existing** session (resuming it if it is cold). Keeps the session's context and workspace; `permissionPreset` re-pins the session's sandbox mode and approval policy before the prompt, and `model` (`provider/model`) overrides the session's model. Without `model` the session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `dsh_list_commands` | The slash commands a session's agent can currently run: the global command layer plus whatever that agent's preset composes, so availability differs per agent preset. |
| `dsh_run_command` | Run one slash command in a session and return its settled `{ kind, text, commandId }`. `line` takes a complete command line (`"/compact"`, `"/permission danger-full-access"`); `command` (+ optional `args`) takes a bare name. The command executes immediately without a model turn. |
| `dsh_list_sessions` | A page of the session index: `sessionId`, title, running state, archival state, activity time, and the recorded owning agent (`view: "full"` adds cwd and liveness). Narrow server-side with `query` (title/cwd/owner/id), `mine: true` (or the `restrictToOwner` setting), `owner: "<id>"`, and `running`; page with `cursor`/`nextCursor`. Archived sessions are hidden unless `includeArchived: true`, mirroring the Web UI. |
| `dsh_read_session` | A window of one session's transcript (user-authored and assistant messages only), plus the last durable `permissionPreset`. `mode: "tail"` (default, last 10) / `"head"` / `"outline"` (one compact row per message with a preview and length, no full text); `roles`, `afterSeq` + `window.nextAfterSeq` to page, `maxChars` (default 2000) to cap a single answer. Reports `totalMessages`, `matchedMessages` and `returned`, so the caller always knows what it has not read. `limit: 0` still means everything. Works while the session is archived. |
| `dsh_answer_request` | Answer a parked decision, only when the deployment sets `answerUserRequests: true`: `decision: "allow"|"deny"` for an approval (a one-shot grant, or a denial) or `answers: [{ id, selected }]` for a question. Ids come from `dsh_list_requests`, which marks what this endpoint parked with `answerable: true`. The GUI stays in the race — whoever decides first wins — and an unanswered request still fails closed at `requestAnswerTimeoutMs`. |
| `dsh_wait_session` | Block until the turn a session is already running ends, then return the assistant text it produced — for `wait: false` starts, GUI-driven sessions, or another caller's work. Never prompts, steers, or cancels: reaching `timeoutMs` returns `status: "timedOut"` with the turn still running, so call it again; `status: "idle"` returns immediately when nothing is running. |
| `dsh_list_requests` | The user decisions a session — or the newest visible sessions, running first — is waiting on: approval requests (`approval/asked` with no matching `approval/decided`, the one-shot permission decision behind a sandbox escalation) and unanswered `ask_user_question` calls, with tool, reason, call id and seq. These audit events are invisible to the model, so this is how a caller learns *why* a delegated turn stopped progressing. Reporting only: the decision is granted in the Harness GUI. |
| `dsh_search_sessions` | Find sessions by content server-side and get bounded snippets instead of transcripts: title/cwd/owner/id (`scope: "title"`) or the messages themselves (`"messages"`, `"both"` by default). Looks at the newest `scan` sessions the caller can see (default 20), reports `where`/`seq`/`snippet` per match, and then `dsh_read_session` reads just that session. |
| `dsh_whoami` | How this endpoint identifies the calling agent — `x-dsh-mcp-client` header, else `initialize` `clientInfo`, else `User-Agent` — plus the sessions that agent created. Attribution, not authentication: callers share the endpoint token. |
| `dsh_cancel_session` | Cancel the active turn of a session without dropping its pending inbox. |
| `dsh_archive_session` | Archive one session durably: hidden from every grouping surface, and it cannot run a model step until restored. A session with running work is refused unless `stopActivity: true` (which archives first, then stops that work). Archiving drops the pin. |
| `dsh_unarchive_session` | Drop a session from the archive set; it is listed again and returns to its recorded workspace position. |
| `dsh_list_permission_presets` | The deployment's permission presets (each bundles a sandbox mode with an approval policy) plus the default for new sessions, for the `permissionPreset` argument above. |
| `dsh_list_tools` | The tools DSH exposes to its own agents, for choosing what a delegated prompt can do; `query` narrows by name or description and `limit` caps the list. |
| `dsh_status` | Endpoint, profile, version, session/live-agent counts, default model, active turns, and the default permission preset. |

Archival needs the Host's `workspaceRegistry` service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace`). Without it the
two archive tools report that the service is unavailable and listings simply omit the `archived`
field instead of guessing.

Permission presets need the Host's `permissionPresets` service
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`). `permissionPreset` is applied through that service's own
`set()` — the same write path as the GUI `/permission` command — once the session is live and before
its prompt is admitted, so the turn's own tool calls already see the chosen sandbox mode and approval
policy. The outcome echoes the applied preset; `dsh_read_session` folds the session's last durable
`permission/preset` event back into its payload, and `dsh_status` carries `defaultPermissionPreset`
plus the catalog. Without the service the permission fields are omitted and
`dsh_list_permission_presets` reports that the service is unavailable. A session created without a
`permissionPreset` keeps the deployment default, exactly as a GUI-created session does.

Commands need the Host's `commands` service and are addressed by **agent**, not by session: the
registry merges a global layer with the layers of the preset that agent is mounted under, so
`dsh_list_commands` must be asked per session and a command such as `/compact` exists only when that
session's preset composes it (`standard`/`ptc`/`cordis` do; `minimal` does not). Execution goes
through the same `commands.execute()` the Web composer uses: the handler runs immediately, the
lifecycle is logged as `command/run` + `command/done`, and **no model turn is started**. `kind` is
`success` or `error`; a line the Host would not parse as a command, or a name it does not know, is
rejected with the available commands listed.

### Progressive disclosure

A session's log runs to megabytes and a Harness can hold hundreds of sessions, so no read is a dump:
each tool takes the smallest question that answers what the caller needs, and every payload says what
it did *not* return.

| Need | Call |
|---|---|
| Which sessions exist? | `dsh_list_sessions({ mine: true, query: "tripothon", limit: 10 })` — index rows are id, title, running, archived, time, owner. |
| The next page | `cursor: nextCursor` from the previous result. |
| What is in a long session? | `dsh_read_session({ sessionId, mode: "outline" })` — role, seq, chars, preview per message. |
| What just happened? | `dsh_read_session({ sessionId })` — the last 10 messages, with `window.reachedEnd`, `totalMessages` and `returned`. |
| Walk it forward | `afterSeq: window.nextAfterSeq`, `roles: ["user"]`, `maxChars: 0` when the full text is really needed. |
| Where was X mentioned? | `dsh_search_sessions({ query: "mount", mine: true })` — snippets from titles/cwd/owners and from the messages of the newest `scan` sessions. |
| Which Harness tools exist? | `dsh_list_tools({ query: "file" })`. |

Costs stay bounded by construction: `scan`, `limit`, `perSession` and `maxChars` are ceilings, not
hints, and a cut message carries `truncated: true` with its real length rather than silently losing
the tail.

### Pending user decisions

A turn can block on something the model never sees: an approval request (`approval/asked`, waiting for
the one-shot permission decision) or an `ask_user_question` call. `dsh_list_requests` folds those
audit events out of the session log — `{ sessionId }` for one session, or a scan of the newest sessions
(running ones first) narrowed by `mine`/`owner` — and returns each request with its tool,
reason, call id and seq. `includeSettled: true` also reports how earlier decisions resolved
(`allowed-once`, `rejected`, `cancelled`, `unavailable`).

Reads and waits surface the same state as a compact `pending` summary, so a `timedOut` wait no longer
leaves the caller guessing.

By default this is **reporting only** — the decision is granted in the Harness GUI. With
`answerUserRequests: true` the endpoint becomes one of the composed answerers: it parks the request
and races it against every other answerer, so the GUI card still works and whoever decides first wins
(the GUI, or `dsh_answer_request`). Only sessions an MCP caller created or adopted are parked unless
`answerOwnedSessionsOnly: false`; an unanswered request fails closed at `requestAnswerTimeoutMs`.
Both halves are Cordis waterfall listeners (`approval/request`, `user-questions/request`), and the
scope filter admits an unscoped listener, which is how a Host plugin receives agent-scoped requests.

### Caller identity and session ownership

Every request is attributed to a calling agent and every session `dsh_run_prompt` creates is recorded
against that agent, so a shared endpoint can answer "which sessions did *this* agent start?":

| Rung | Signal | Example |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `x-dsh-mcp-client` request header (or `--client` / `DSH_MCP_CLIENT` on the stdio bridge); a version may follow as `name@version` | `codex`, `claude-code@2.1.295` |
| 2 | the `clientInfo` block MCP clients send on `initialize`, cached per transport | `claude-code 2.0.1` |
| 3 | `User-Agent` | `cursor/1.2` |
| 4 | the auth peer (the bearer token, or DSH connection trust) | `token` |

A rung never borrows from a lower one: a caller that sets the header is named by that label alone, even
if another client's `clientInfo` shares its User-Agent. `dsh_whoami` returns the resolved identity, its
`source` rung, and the sessions that agent created;
`dsh_list_sessions` annotates each row with `owner` and `mine`, and accepts `mine: true`. The registry
lives in `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-clients.json` (0600), so ownership survives a Harness restart.

This is **attribution, not authentication**: every caller presents the same endpoint token, and a
client may name itself anything with the header. Set `restrictToOwner: true` to turn the record into
isolation — a caller can then only list, read, wait on, continue, cancel, archive, or run commands in
the sessions it created (or adopted: a session with no recorded owner, such as one the GUI started,
is adopted by the first caller that drives it). A session owned by someone else is refused with a
diagnostic naming the owner.

Resources: `dsh://status`, `dsh://sessions`, and the template `dsh://session/{sessionId}`.

### Waiting for a turn

`dsh_run_prompt` and `dsh_continue_session` wait for their own turn by default. When a call must not
block for the whole turn, start it with `wait: false` and follow it with `dsh_wait_session`:

| Result | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `status: "completed"` / `"error"` | The turn ended; `text` is what it produced and `turnEndReason` is the Host's reason. |
| `status: "timedOut"` | `timeoutMs` was reached and the turn is **still running** — call `dsh_wait_session` again. |
| `status: "idle"` | No turn was running, so the call returned immediately. |

No wait path cancels or steers the session: a reached ceiling and a disconnected caller both only stop
waiting. A client with its own call timeout can therefore set `timeoutMs` below it and re-wait instead
of polling `dsh_read_session` in a loop. Only `dsh_cancel_session` stops a turn.

## Endpoint and authentication

On activation the plugin registers `POST /mcp` on the Harness web server (default
`http://127.0.0.1:19387`) and writes connection details to:

```
$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json      # mode 0600
{ "url": "...", "token": "...", "stdioBridge": "...", "tools": [...] }
```

Every request must present the bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

The token is **generated per activation** unless you configure a fixed one. Set a fixed token
whenever another harness keeps a saved config, because a generated token changes on every Harness
restart. In the desktop profile the `dsh-mcp-server` row carries one:

```yaml
- id: dsh-mcp-server
  disabled: false
  config:
    token: "<fixed token>"     # mirrored in the endpoint file and in the selfcheck bundle
```

Requests that already pass DSH's own connection trust (`ctx.connection`) are also accepted, so local
tooling that holds the Harness token works too.

The endpoint file is owned by the activation that wrote it: on a config hot-reload the outgoing
instance removes it only when it is still the owner, so the replacement instance's file is never
deleted mid-reload.

## Configuration

The bundle row in `cordis.patch.yml` accepts (all optional):

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `/mcp` | Route path on the Harness web server. |
| `token` | generated | Fixed bearer token; set this so external configs stay stable across restarts. |
| `url` | `$DSH_WEB_URL` or `http://127.0.0.1:19387` | Advertised base URL written to the endpoint file. |
| `endpointFile` | `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json` | Where connection details are published. |
| `writeEndpointFile` | `true` | Publish the endpoint file at all. |
| `allowConnectionAuth` | `true` | Also accept requests admitted by `ctx.connection`. |
| `defaultCwd` | Harness default | Working directory for sessions started without `cwd`. |
| `defaultModel` | Harness default model | `{ provider, model, reasoningEffort? }` for **newly started** sessions without an explicit `model`. A continued session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `turnTimeoutMs` | `1800000` | Default wait ceiling for a tool call that waits for a turn. Reaching it stops the wait, never the turn. |
| `maxConcurrentTurns` | `8` | Concurrent waited turns before new calls queue. `dsh_wait_session` starts no turn and takes no slot. |
| `answerUserRequests` | `false` | Become one of the deployment's answerers: park approvals and questions for sessions this endpoint drives so a caller can settle them with `dsh_answer_request`, racing the GUI (whoever decides first wins). |
| `answerOwnedSessionsOnly` | `true` | With answering on, only sessions an MCP caller created or adopted are parked; the GUI keeps every other card. |
| `requestAnswerTimeoutMs` | `600000` | How long a parked request waits for an MCP answer before it fails closed. |
| `restrictToOwner` | `false` | Confine each caller to the sessions it created or adopted: other sessions are refused by id, and `dsh_list_sessions` returns only its own. |
| `clientsFile` | `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-clients.json` | Where the caller registry (agents seen + session owners) is kept, mode 0600. |
| `clientsFlushMs` | `5000` | How long registry writes are coalesced before they hit disk. |
| `maxBodyBytes` | `8388608` | Request body ceiling. |
| `instructions` | built-in text | Replaces the instructions handed to the calling model. |

Example row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-mcp-server
      name: '@local/dsh-mcp-server'
      config:
        token: !!js process.env.DSH_MCP_TOKEN
        defaultCwd: /Users/me/work
```

## Connecting another harness

### 1. Streamable HTTP (no extra process)

Point the client at the endpoint with the bearer token:

```jsonc
// Claude Code / Cursor style MCP config
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dsh": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:19387/mcp",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <token from dsh-mcp-endpoint.json>" }
    }
  }
}
```

### 2. stdio (harnesses that only spawn a command)

`bin/dsh-mcp-stdio.mjs` is a dependency-free stdio↔HTTP bridge. It discovers the endpoint from
`$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json` (override with `--url`/`--token` or `DSH_MCP_URL`/`DSH_MCP_TOKEN`):

```jsonc
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dsh": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["<path-to-dsh-mcp-server>/bin/dsh-mcp-stdio.mjs"]
    }
  }
}
```

It forwards JSON-RPC messages verbatim, cancels the upstream request when the client sends
`notifications/cancelled`, and keeps stdout clean (diagnostics go to stderr). It also names its
launcher to the endpoint through `x-dsh-mcp-client`, from `--client <label>`, else
`DSH_MCP_CLIENT`, else the parent process name, else `stdio-bridge` — set the variable in the other
harness' MCP server config when the parent is a bare runtime such as `node`.

Because GUI clients launch with a minimal `PATH`, point `command` at an absolute Node binary and rely
on the bridge's `~/.dsh` discovery (both verified with only `HOME` and `PATH` set):

| Client | Config file | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code (user scope) | `~/.claude.json` | `mcpServers.dsh` |
| Claude Desktop | `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` | `mcpServers.dsh` |
| ChatGPT desktop / Codex | `~/.codex/config.toml` | `[mcp_servers.dsh]` |

```toml
# Codex / ChatGPT desktop
[mcp_servers.dsh]
type = "stdio"
command = "/absolute/path/to/node"
args = ["<path-to-dsh-mcp-server>/bin/dsh-mcp-stdio.mjs"]
startup_timeout_sec = 60
```

Restart the client after editing its config. A cloud MCP client (for example a web connector) cannot
reach a loopback endpoint at all — that needs a tunnel and a deliberate networking change.

### 3. DSH as its own MCP client

DSH ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; a row like this registers this server's tools inside DSH as
`mcp__dsh__dsh_run_prompt`, …:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-dsh
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: dsh
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://127.0.0.1:19387/mcp
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.DSH_MCP_TOKEN}`'
```

## Install into a profile

```bash
git clone https://github.com/baitouwuya/dsh-mcp-server.git
# then, from the Harness UI / plugin_manager:
plugin_manager install_bundle --target /path/to/dsh-mcp-server
```

or, equivalently, `action: install_bundle` with the absolute package directory as `target`.

### Self-check bundle (optional)

`selfcheck/` is a second, tiny bundle (`@local/dsh-mcp-selfcheck`) that registers DSH's **own** MCP
client against this server, so the published endpoint is continuously exercised and its tools appear
inside DSH as `mcp__dsh__*`. It is pure verification — disable or skip it if you do not want a
self-loop in every session:

```bash
plugin_manager install_bundle --target /path/to/dsh-mcp-server/selfcheck
```

The committed `cordis.patch.yml` carries **no literal token** (this is a public repository): set
`DSH_MCP_TOKEN` in the Harness environment, or patch the `mcp-dsh-selfcheck` row from your own
private profile, with the token the server is configured with.

## Verification

```bash
node test/mcp-self-test.mjs            # 11 transport checks, no Harness needed
node test/plugin-integration-test.mjs  # 67 checks: apply(), endpoint file, tools, transcript windows,
                                       # outline/paging/truncation, search, index cursors, pending user
                                       # decisions, parked approvals/questions answered over MCP, waiting,
                                       # caller identity + restrictToOwner, archival tools, permissions,
                                       # commands, model pinning, hot-reload ownership
node test/stdio-bridge-test.mjs        # 4 checks, needs a RUNNING Harness (one real delegated turn)
node test/live-e2e-test.mjs            # 41 checks over HTTP: protocol, resources, all seventeen tools,
                                       # archive/unarchive, permission presets, commands, error paths,
                                       # 4 real turns (needs a Harness)
```

Live checks used during development also covered: a real MCP client exchange against the running
Harness, an end-to-end `dsh_run_prompt` → `dsh_continue_session` → `dsh_read_session` flow, permission
presets applied and re-pinned over MCP and folded back out of the transcript, a command executed
without adding a model message, waiting on a detached turn without cancelling it, caller identity
over the header and User-Agent rungs, windowed/outlined transcript reads, detached start + cancel,
and the stdio bridge.

## Notes and limitations

- **Code changes need a Harness restart.** Re-enabling a bundle reloads its row but reuses the
  already-imported module generation, so edited plugin code only takes effect after restarting DSH.
  Config changes reach the running instance immediately; changing a bundle's package path may report
  `restart-required`.
- **The bearer token is a local secret.** The desktop profile keeps it in
  `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`, and `selfcheck/cordis.patch.yml` repeats it. Rotate by
  updating both places. It authorizes full DSH session control over loopback, so treat it accordingly.
- **Localhost only.** The endpoint rides the Harness web server, which binds loopback. Exposing it to
  another machine is a deliberate networking change, not a plugin setting.
- **Approval and user questions.** A turn started over MCP runs with the session's own approval and
  sandbox policy (`permissionPreset`, or the deployment default); if a delegated turn needs approval,
  the prompt appears in the Harness GUI like any other session. Switching a session's preset from the
  GUI (`/permission`) and over MCP write the same durable events, so the last writer wins per session.
- **Commands are immediate and per agent.** `dsh_run_command` runs on the addressed agent's command
  layer (global + that agent's preset), so a preset-scoped command such as `/compact` may be absent for
  another session. It is not queued behind a running turn and it can mutate session state
  (`/permission`), so it carries the same authority as typing the command in the GUI; `dsh_list_commands`
  first is the way to know what a session accepts.
- Sessions started over MCP are ordinary DSH sessions: they appear in the Harness session list and can
  be opened and continued in the GUI.

## License

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-plugin-yon-panel

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI 的 **Yon 按钮面板** 插件，带一个**项目存储**。

| 半边 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| 浏览器半 | 侧栏底部、设置按钮**上方**一个 `Y` 图标 → 点开是按钮面板，里面十个内建格子：**项目管理**、**技能**、**数据源**、**知识库**、**消化检查**、**Home 管理**、**迭代**、**浏览器**、**需求**、**记忆**；面板里的按钮由任意插件通过 `yon.panel.item` 席位贡献 |
| Host 半 | 「项目」存储（主表 + 动态字段子表），以三种方式对外开放：`ctx.yonProjects` 服务（同进程插件）、`project_*` agent 工具（在对话里说人话改配置）、`/yon/api` HTTP 路由（任何前端） |
| Host 半 | 插件**自带技能**：`skills/*/SKILL.md` 在构建时内联，插件挂载时注册进 DSH 的技能目录，**卸载时自动消失**；开关存在 `yon_skills` 领域里 |
| Host 半 | **需求条目库**：某个项目下「要做的事」一条条记下来，连同使用者给的资料、模型生成的方案与补丁。以 `ctx.yonRequirements` + 9 个 `requirement_*` 工具 + `/yon/api` 三种方式对外开放；每条是 `~/.dsh/yon-panel/requirements/` 下的一个目录 |
| Host 半 | **项目记忆**：某个项目上已经摸出来的坑、环境事实、决定与偏好，给下一个会话用。4 个 `memory_*` 工具；模型可写可改、**不能删**；`project_read` 的返回值里会自动带上这个项目最近的五条。面板（侧栏第 10 格「记忆」）能浏览、按类型与项目筛选、读全文与删除 |

**安装不需要改动 DSH 仓库**：UI 占用 ui-sidebar 已声明的 `sidebar.footer.action` 席位，数据落在 DSH 自带的 storage 子系统上。

## 安装

前提：本机已装 DSH（命令行里有 `dsh`，或从源码 checkout 用 `pnpm dsh`）。

```sh
# 从 git 安装（本仓库已提交构建产物 lib/，无需任何构建授权）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:beckoningcoco/yon-plugin
dsh --profile web

# 或者 npm / tarball
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-yon-panel
pnpm pack && dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-yon-panel-0.1.0.tgz

# 卸载
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-yon-panel
```

装完启动，侧栏底部（设置按钮上方）出现 `Y` 图标。

> ⚠️ **不要手动再往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写一遍这个插件行。**
> `dsh plugin add` 已经把包写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，插件行由那一层提供；profile 的 patch 层再 `insert`
> 一次同一个 `id`，**冷启动会直接失败**：
> `failed to apply loader entry include: duplicate loader entry id: yon-panel`。
> 阴险之处在于：运行中的热重载会按 `id` 去重，所以这个错误在服务器跑着的时候完全看不出来，
> 直到你下一次重启才发现。需要"不重启就挂上"时，请另起一个独立 profile/端口的实例验证，别动生产 profile 的 patch 层。

## 项目存储（Host 半）

### 表设计：主表 + 子表

```
projects        主表：列表与下拉菜单只读它
  key   = projectId (uuid)
  value = { name, code, status, archived, createdAt, updatedAt }

project_fields  子表：动态字段，一行一个
  key   = <projectId>_<编码后的字段名>
  value = { projectId, fieldKey, value, updatedAt }
```

- **加/删字段 = 加/删一行**，主表结构不动，所以永远不需要迁移
- 改不同字段是**各自独立的一次原子写** → 两个功能同时编辑同一个项目的不同字段不会互相覆盖
- 列表/下拉只读主表（`fieldCount` 由一次遍历算出），不会因为动态字段膨胀而变慢

> ⚠️ **记录键必须路径安全**（`^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$`）：`per-record` 介质把每条记录存成一个文件，键就是文件名。中文、斜杠、点、空格在字段名里都合法，在键里都非法 —— 所以字段名会按字节编码（`环境信息new` → `_e7_8e_af_e5_a2_83_e4_bf_a1_e6_81_afnew`）。字段名本身存在记录里，**键从不被解码**，因此键只是唯一标识，语义一律从记录读。

### HTTP API

所有路径以 `/yon/api` 开头（前缀路由，同源即可调用）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/yon/api/projects?archived=1` | 项目列表（主表；默认不含已归档） |
| `POST` | `/yon/api/projects` | 新建 `{ name, code?, status?, fields? }` |
| `GET` | `/yon/api/projects/<id>` | 详情（含动态字段） |
| `PATCH` | `/yon/api/projects/<id>` | 改名 / 编码 / 状态 / 归档 |
| `DELETE` | `/yon/api/projects/<id>` | 删除项目并级联删除它的字段行 |
| `POST` | `/yon/api/projects/<id>/archive` | 软删除 / 恢复（`{ archived }`，缺省 `true`） |
| `PUT` | `/yon/api/projects/<id>/fields/<字段名>` | 写一个动态字段 `{ value }` |
| `DELETE` | `/yon/api/projects/<id>/fields/<字段名>` | 删一个动态字段 |
| `GET` | `/yon/api/skills` | 技能列表：本插件自带的在前、你自己的在后，另带 `complete`（来源是否全部读到） |
| `GET` | `/yon/api/skills/<技能名>` | 一个技能，含正文 |
| `PATCH` | `/yon/api/skills/<技能名>` | 开关本插件自带的某个技能 `{ enabled }` |

字段名走 URL 段，需要 `encodeURIComponent`（中文/斜杠都没问题）。

> ⚠️ `PATCH /yon/api/skills/<技能名>` **只接受本插件自带的技能名**，其它名字一律 404。这条路由无法用来改动你自己技能目录里的任何东西。

### 同进程引用（给其他插件）

```ts
// 只读（比如做一个「项目下拉菜单」）
export const inject = ['yonProjects']

const projects = ctx.yonProjects.list()          // 主表：快、够下拉用
const detail = ctx.yonProjects.get(id)           // 含动态字段
const stop = ctx.yonProjects.subscribe(() => {   // 变更通知（来自 domain/changed）
  // 重新读 list()/get()
})
```

写入同理：`create` / `update` / `setField` / `removeField` / `remove`。

技能服务同理：

```ts
export const inject = ['yonSkills']

const { skills, complete } = await ctx.yonSkills.list()  // 自带技能在前，自己的在后
await ctx.yonSkills.setEnabled('yon-devkit', false)      // 只对本插件自带的技能有效，其余抛 not-found
const detail = await ctx.yonSkills.read('yon-devkit')    // 含正文
```

### 数据落在哪、用什么介质

默认走 DSH 自带的 `json` 后端 → `$DSH_HOME/storages/yon_projects/{projects,project_fields}/*.json`。

想要 **SQLite 介质**：在 profile 里挂 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-sqlite` 并把本领域路由指过去即可，**插件代码不用改**（介质由部署方选，见 DSH 的 storage 子系统文档）。

不走存储领域的三个域落在 `~/.dsh/yon-panel/` 下 —— 这个目录在**重装插件之后还在**，这是它们放在这里而不是插件目录里的理由：

| 是什么 | 落在哪 | 形态 |
|---|---|---|
| 需求条目 | `requirements/` | `index.json`（目录卡）+ 每条一个目录：`entry.md` + `user/` `generated/` `patches/` |
| 项目记忆 | `memory/` | `index.json` + 每条一个 `<id>.md`（frontmatter + 正文，人和 `git diff` 都能读） |
| 迭代表板 | `iteration.json` | 一个 JSON 文档 |

**记忆库的索引是缓存，文件才是真相。** `memory_read` 与 `memory_recall` 都从 `.md` 读；索引只服务注入路径——`project_read` 不能为了带一行标题去开五个文件。所以手工编辑一个 `.md` 是允许的用法（下一次 `memory_read` 就看到你的改动），索引因此落后只会**少给**一条，不会给错一条；重建索引是 `memory_sweep` 的事（P2）。

### 让 Agent 帮你管配置（模型工具）

Host 半把这份存储同时注册成 **agent 工具**，所以你可以直接在对话里说人话：

> 把「用友 NCC 客开」的环境信息改成 10.0.0.9
> 给「用友 NCC 客开」加一个字段：负责人 = 张三
> 新建一个项目叫「BIP 旗舰版客开」，编码 BIP-1
> 把「旧项目」删掉

注册的工具：

| 工具 | 作用 | 会不会丢东西 |
|---|---|---|
| `project_list` | 列出项目（可按关键词过滤、可含已归档） | 不会 |
| `project_read` | 读一个项目及其全部字段（改之前模型必须先读） | 不会 |
| `project_create` | 新建项目，可带初始字段 | 不会（只新增） |
| `project_update` | 改名 / 改编码 / 改状态 / 写字段 | 不会（结果里会列出改了什么） |
| `project_update`，带 `remove_fields` 或 `archived` | 删字段 / 归档 / 恢复 | **会** |
| `project_delete` | 彻底删除项目及其全部字段 | **会** |

在需要确认的档位下，**破坏性的写入会先停下来等你确认**，而且确认时给你的不是「即将执行 project_update」，而是**改动清单**：

```
修改项目「用友 NCC 客开」：
· 状态：进行中 → 已暂停
· 字段「环境信息」：「10.0.0.1」→「10.0.0.9」
· 删除字段「旧字段」（原值 x）
```

没批准就不会落库 —— 这一步走的是框架自己的审批闸门（`tools/pre-execute` 返回 `{kind:'ask'}`），除了「允许一次」以外的任何回答都按拒绝处理。一次调用确实没有改动时，预览会直说「项目「X」没有任何改动。」

**要不要确认，由会话的权限档决定** —— 插件只声明「这次调用会不会丢东西」，剩下的跟随你用 `/permission` 选的那一档：

| 会话权限档 | 只增改的写入 | 破坏性的写入（删字段 / 归档 / 删项目） |
|---|---|---|
| 仅可查看（`read-only`） | ⛔ 明确拒绝 | ⛔ 明确拒绝 |
| 工作区内修改（`workspace-write`，`approval: ask`） | ✅ 直接写入 | ✋ 先给你确认清单 |
| 完全权限（`danger-full-access`，`approval: never`） | ✅ 直接写入 | ✅ 直接写入 |

判断依据是会话日志里最新的 `sandbox/mode` 与 `approval/policy` 两个事件，也就是 `/permission` 切换的那两个旋钮。取不到时（工具被直接调用、调用没有 agent 上下文）按最保守的一档处理：破坏性写入先问。

想改成「任何写入都要确认」，把 `src/host/tools.ts` 里 `dispositionOf()` 的最后一行改成 `return 'ask'` 即可 —— 确认清单的代码已经在那儿了。

> ℹ️ 只读档下的写入会拿到一条明确的拒绝理由（「当前会话是「仅可查看」权限…」），而不是静默失败。

几个设计取舍：

- **解析自然语言的模型就是你在对话的那个模型**：提示词、模型选择、凭据、重试、会话记录全部由 DSH 的 agent loop 负责，插件只声明「能做什么」和「改之前给人看什么」，因此**不含任何模型客户端**，也不需要在插件里配置 API key。
- **项目可以用名字指代**：`project` 参数接受 id、名称或编码。名字撞车时它不猜，而是把候选列出来让人挑。
- **读工具不设闸门**，否则每次问「我有哪些项目」都得点一次批准。
- **参数校验在工具自己手里**：模型给的参数不合法（比如 `fields` 不是对象、项目名是空白）会被拒绝并回一条它能看懂的错误，而不是写进去半个记录。

> ⚠️ **需要重启 DSH**：工具是 host 半注册的，改完插件必须重启才生效（浏览器半只需要刷新页面）。

### 其余各域的工具

上面那 5 个 `project_*` 只是其中一个域。同一个闸门（判据只有一条：**这次调用会不会丢东西**）、同一份权限档表格，覆盖全部工具族：

| 工具族 | 干什么 | 会写到哪里 |
|---|---|---|
| `requirement_*`（9 个） | 需求条目库：建条目、追加标注、改名称与状态、作废、写方案文档与补丁、读条目内的附件。**创建与追加永不打断**（这是它有价值的前提），改名称、改状态、作废走审批，**没有删除工具**——真删只在面板里 | `~/.dsh/yon-panel/requirements/` |
| `memory_*`（5 个） | 项目记忆：`memory_write` 新建、`memory_update` 改写、`memory_recall` 检索、`memory_read` 读全文、`memory_sweep` 体检（六项检查，另可 `repair` 从文件重建索引）。新建与体检不打断，**改写会拦**（它盖掉原来那段话），没有删除工具 | `~/.dsh/yon-panel/memory/` |
| `datasource_*` | 登记的环境数据库连接，以及执行 SQL 取真实数据 | `db_config.json` |
| `ncc_home_*` | 登记本机 NCC/BIP 安装目录（Home），按 id 列文件、按原编码读文件 | `home_config.json` |
| `ncc_meta_*` / `bip_meta_*` | 两条产品线的元数据：实体 / 表名 / 字段 / 枚举。**两条产品线互不相通**，问错一条只会答"没有" | 只读（索引是缓存） |
| `wiki_*` / `wiki_write` | 读实体知识库；写入分三种模式，**不能覆盖已有页** | Obsidian vault 目录 |
| `knowledge_*` / `ncc_class_search` / `doc_parse` / `ncc_gbk_edit` | 随包参考库、类名→jar 索引、Excel/PDF/Word 读取、GBK 源码读写 | 只有 `ncc_gbk_edit` 写，改的是 NCC 源码树 |
| `digest_*` | 素材消化的摸底与验收（只管计划与校验，真正落页的是 `wiki_write`） | `digest-log.jsonl` |
| `iteration_*`（2 个） | 插件自身短板的台账：模型**只能追加**，改状态、调优先级、删除都在面板里由人做 | `iteration.json` |

**其中四个工具的回答末尾会带一行记忆计数**（`datasource_query` / `ncc_meta_find` / `bip_meta_find` / `wiki_lookup`）。它们的参数里都没有项目，却最常发生在某一个项目的活上——所以 `project_read` 一旦解析出项目，插件就把「本次会话现在在这个项目上」记下来，这四个工具随后附一句「本项目记着 N 条记忆（memory_recall 可查）」。一次会话一个项目只说一次。

模型真正逐字读到的那段总纲在 `src/host/prompt.ts`（系统提示里的一节，**组数是写下来的**：新增一组工具就要同步改那段文字与它的测试）。上面这张表是给人看的。

### 插件自带技能

插件在 `skills/<名字>/SKILL.md` 里预制技能。构建时正文被**内联**进 `lib/host/skill-catalog.generated.js`，插件挂载时通过 `ctx.skills.register()` 注册进 DSH 的技能目录：

```
skills/yon-devkit/SKILL.md            ← 你编辑的源文件（普通技能 bundle，带 frontmatter）
        ↓  pnpm build（scripts/build-skills.mjs）
src/host/skill-catalog.generated.ts   ← 生成物，已提交，不要手改
        ↓  tsc
lib/host/skill-catalog.generated.js   ← 随包发布
        ↓  插件挂载时 ctx.skills.register()
当前会话的技能目录                     ← 出现在模型的技能列表和 /技能名 里
```

**为什么内联，而不是安装时写文件**：

- **卸载即消失，零残留**。技能是「随插件生命周期存在」的同进程值，从不落到你的技能目录里，所以不存在「删一半失败留下半个 bundle」这种事。注册返回的是 Cordis 的 effect disposer，插件卸载时自动注销并让技能目录缓存失效。
- **不用解析运行时路径**。运行时读文件，得先相对一个可能被 loader 从任意位置加载的 bundle 定位 `skills/`，而且在没有真实文件系统的部署上直接失败。
- **注册是同步的**，插件一挂载，技能目录就是完整的。

**优先级**（DSH 自己的规则，不是本插件定的，数字小者胜）：

| rank | 位置 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| 100 | `<git 根>/.dsh/skills` | project-dsh |
| 200 | `<git 根>/.agents/skills` | project-agents |
| 300 | `customSkillDirs` | custom |
| — | **本插件注册的运行时技能** | runtime |
| 400 | `~/.dsh/skills` | user-dsh |
| 500 | `~/.agents/skills` | user-agents |
| 600 | `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR` | bundled |

也就是说自带技能**压过你装在 `~/.agents/skills` 里的同名技能，但压不过某个项目仓库里 pin 住的版本**。本插件因此刻意只用新名字，不碰你现有的通用技能。

当前只带一个占位技能 `yon-devkit`（用友客开项目的配置入口，正文里划清了与 `ncc-dev` / `yonyou-bip-dev` 的分工）。

**开关**：`YONSKILL` 面板里可以单独停用某个自带技能，状态存在 `yon_skills` 领域（`$DSH_HOME/storages/yon_skills/skill_preferences/*.json`），下次启动按它决定注册哪些。停用只是不注册，不删任何东西。

> ⚠️ **需要重启 DSH**：技能由 host 半注册。改完 `skills/*.md` 要 `pnpm build` 并重启，只刷新页面不会重新注册。

## 按钮面板（浏览器半）

侧栏底部的 `Y` 图标点开是 280px 的小面板。面板内有十个内建格子（悬停显示名字）：

| 格子 | 名字 | 打开什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 文件夹图标 | 项目管理 | 项目列表 + 字段编辑 |
| 文档图标 | **YONSKILL** | 技能面板 |
| 其余八个 | 数据源 / 知识库 / 消化检查 / Home 管理 / 迭代 / 浏览器 / 需求 / 记忆 | 各自的面板 |

> 「浏览器」是**调试浏览器**（起一个带 `--remote-debugging-port` 的 Chrome/Edge/Firefox，交给 Playwright 之类的工具接管），
> 与上文「浏览器半」（插件跑在客户端的那半边）不是一回事。设计说明见 [`docs/yon-browser-design.md`](docs/yon-browser-design.md)。

### 项目管理界面怎么用

点开格子，弹出一个**原生对话框**（DSH 自己的 Modal：遮罩、Esc、右上角关闭、关闭后焦点回到格子），左右两栏：

| 操作 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 新建项目 | 左栏顶部「+ 新建项目」→ 弹出小对话框，填名称（必填）+ 编码（可留空）→「创建」；建好自动选中并滚动到它 |
| 选项目 | 点左栏一行；也能用 ↑/↓ 在列表里走 |
| 找项目 | 项目到 8 个以上时左栏顶部出现搜索框（按名称或编码过滤） |
| 改名 / 改编码 | 点标题或编码文字就地编辑：回车或失焦保存，Esc 放弃 |
| 改状态 | 标题下方的「进行中 / 已暂停 / 已完成」三个胶囊，点一下就切 |
| 看字段值 | 值默认**是一段文字**（不是输入框）：长的整段换行显示，看得全。结构化值（对象、数组，或本身就是 JSON 文本的那种）读成**键值列表**，键一列值一列；嵌套深过一层才退回缩进的 JSON |
| 改字段值 | **点一下值**才变成输入框（整行宽、跟着内容长高）：**失焦即存**（回车等于失焦），Esc 放弃。每行右侧自己显示「保存中…／已保存／未保存，点这里重试」，某一行失败**不会**锁住别的行（失败的那行会把输入框连同原文一起摊开，重试就是「再存这段」） |
| 复制字段值 | 字段行右侧的复制图标：把该字段**存着的那一串**放进剪贴板（编辑中未保存的文本也能复制；键值列表虽然读成列表，复制的仍是原来那串 JSON），按钮自己报「已复制／复制失败」；空值不可复制 |
| 加字段 | 「字段」标题右侧「+ 新增字段」→ 出现一行，填字段名 + 值 →「添加」（回车也行），可连着加 |
| 删字段 | 字段行右侧 `×` → 小对话框确认 |
| 归档 / 恢复 | 右栏「归档」；归档后默认列表里不再出现，勾上「显示已归档」能找回来 |
| 彻底删除 | 右栏「彻底删除」→ **风险确认对话框**：勾选「我了解此操作无法撤销」后才能点「确认删除」（连同它的全部字段行） |
| 关闭 | 右上角 ×、点遮罩、或按 Esc |

层的顺序是有讲究的：**一次 Esc 只关最上面那一层**。打开「新建项目」或风险确认时，Esc 关的是那个对话框，而不是它下面的项目界面；项目界面开着时，Esc 也不会顺手把侧栏小面板一起关掉（面板在这期间暂停响应 Esc 与点外关闭）。

几个产品层面的决定：

- **输入法安全**：所有「回车提交」的位置都做了 composition 保护 —— 中文拼音选词按的回车不会被当成提交（否则会把「环境信」这种半成品写成字段名）。
- **值只有在看起来是结构化 JSON 时才按 JSON 存**（`{...}` / `[...]` / `true` / `false` / `null`），其余一律存文本 —— 否则 `13800138000` 会被当数字、18 位订单号会被静默截断精度。
- **读法与写法是两种样子**：读到的是文字（或键值列表），点开才成为输入框 —— 常驻的单行框把长值的尾巴藏在框里（真实 store 里一格能有 240 字）。编辑永远从**存着的那串原文**开始，「点开又没改」不会产生一次写。
- **能用原生原子就用**：按钮、输入框、对话框、风险确认、胶囊都来自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`（页面模块表提供的那一份：零体积、与宿主同一实现），颜色一律走主题 token。
- **危险操作按风险分级**：删字段是局部小影响 → 小对话框确认；删项目不可逆 → 勾选式风险确认。
- **组件不取数、不订阅**：`createProjectApi()` 在 `apply` 里建一次，通过条目的 inject face 投影进组件，组件拿到的是一组回调 —— 所以组件测试可以完全脱开 host 跑。

### 技能面板（YONSKILL）怎么用

同样是原生对话框，左右两栏，技能按来源**分成两组**：

| 操作 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 看技能 | 点左栏一行；↑/↓ 也能走；技能到 8 个以上时出现搜索框（按名字或描述过滤） |
| 看用途 | 右栏显示描述、触发时机（有的话）、来源 |
| 看正文 | 右栏底部是技能正文原文（等宽、可滚动） |
| 开关自带技能 | 「插件提供」组里的技能，右栏有「停用 / 启用」按钮；停用的行变暗并标「已停用」 |
| 关闭 | 右上角 ×、点遮罩、或按 Esc |

两组的分工是**强制**的，不只是文案：

- **插件提供**：插件自带（`source = yon-panel`），可以停用 / 启用。
- **其他全局技能**：任何**部署级**注册的技能，面板**只读**。host 侧的 `PATCH /yon/api/skills/<名字>` 只接受本插件自带的技能名，别的名字一律 404 —— 所以就算将来前端写错，也动不了别的技能。

> ℹ️ **为什么看不见 `~/.agents/skills` 里那 15 个技能？** 这不是漏做，是 DSH 的层次设计。`skill` 注册表是 host + per-scope 分层的：**部署级** provider（repository 插件、本插件注册的技能）进 **global 层**，而磁盘发现（`skill-filesystem`）由**每个 agent 预设各自挂载**、进那个预设的层；会话读的是「global + 自己作用域链」的合并结果。面板走 HTTP、背后没有会话，命名不出某个 agent 的作用域，所以只能读 global 层。DSH 自己的 bundle patch 也把「repository plugins 注册进 global 层」写成这个结构的预期用法。
>
> 换句话说：**这个面板管的是「插件给你装了什么」，不是「这个会话现在能用什么」**。后者本来就该按会话问 —— 直接 `/技能名`，或让模型用 `skill` 工具。

给面板加按钮（本插件不用改）：

```ts
ctx.slots.inject('yon.panel.item', () => ctx.slots.register({
  name: 'yon.panel.item',
  id: 'my-feature',
  order: 100,
}, MyButton))
```

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck   # tsc --noEmit（host + client + tests）
pnpm test        # vitest（699 个用例 / 50 个文件）
pnpm build       # 先把 skills/*.md 内联成 TS，再 tsc 出 host 半，最后 tsdown 出浏览器半
pnpm verify      # 产物自检（loader 契约、externals、样式注入、host ESM、patch 层、技能目录）
pnpm pack        # 打包，prepack 会先 build
```

构建是**分工**的，两边原因不同：

| 半边 | 用什么构建 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json` | Node 直接加载 ESM；相对导入被重写成 `.js`，裸包保持真实 import（由本包依赖解析）。用打包器反而会让 DSH 进程拿到第二份 storage-domain |
| 浏览器 | `tsdown` | 必须产出 loader 的 lazy-CJS factory（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`），并把 CSS Modules 编译后注入 `<style>` |

- **host 半改动需要重启 DSH 才生效**（client 半能靠 HMR 热更）
- `src/shared/types.ts` 是两半共用的数据契约，前后端不会漂移
- 基线 externals 名单抄自 harness 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web/src/platform.ts`；升级 DSH 大版本时对照一次
- **构建是可复现的**：CSS Module 的类名映射按名排序输出，所以提交的 `lib/` 与重新构建的结果逐字节一致（lightningcss 自己给出的导出顺序会变，排序就是为了消掉这个假差异）。这一点可以自己验：跑完 `pnpm build` 之后 `git status` 应该是干净的
- **技能正文由 codegen 内联**：`pnpm build` 会先跑 `scripts/build-skills.mjs`，把 `skills/<名字>/SKILL.md` 的前言与正文写进 `src/host/skill-catalog.generated.ts`（已提交）。`pnpm verify` 用 `--check` 抓漂移 —— 改了 `SKILL.md` 却忘了重新生成，会在这一步失败，而不是悄悄发布旧内容
- **改界面**：预览出图（`preview/render.spec.tsx` + `preview/shots.mjs`）只做校验，**不产出可运行产物**；要让界面真的变，必须 `pnpm build`。面板 UI 的优化结论、陷阱清单与验收步骤见 `docs/yon-panel-ui-design.md`

### 为什么 `lib/` 被提交进 git

`dsh plugin add github:...` 拿到的是**源码而非构建产物**，而 pnpm ≥10 默认拒绝执行依赖的构建脚本。把 `lib/` 一起提交，使用者无需任何构建授权。改完源码记得 `pnpm build` 并提交 `lib/`。

## 已知限制

- **agent 工具依赖部署**：模型那一步由 DSH 的 agent loop 负责，所以所在 profile 需要有 `tools` 服务与可用的模型凭据。缺凭据的环境（例如没配 key 的 `headless` profile）里界面照常可用，但"说人话改配置"这条路径走不通
- **字段名不能改名**：字段名就是这条记录的身份键，改名等于「写新键 + 删旧键」两次写，中途失败会留下两个字段。要改就删掉重建
- **删除没有撤销**：归档可以恢复，删字段/删项目不行。界面里的删除有小对话框 / 风险确认；agent 工具的删除是否确认取决于会话权限档（见上文）——**完全权限档下会直接删掉，不再询问**
- **值只能手输**：没有类型选择器或富编辑，结构化值要自己写 JSON 文本
- **无跨记录事务**：原子性单位是一条记录。`create({ name, fields })` 是「主表 1 写 + 子表 N 写」，中途失败可能留下缺字段的项目（字段缺失可容忍，界面显示为空）
- **领域版本不是迁移器**：改主表 schema 后旧记录会被校验拒绝、导致领域打不开；演进时请升 `version` 并把旧记录缺的字段声明为 optional
- **无二级索引**：按字段筛选/排序只能在应用层做（数据全量在内存；这类需求出现时说明该字段该「转正」成主表列，或改用 SQLite 关系表）
- **自带技能只在装了插件的 profile 里存在**：它们是运行时注册的，所以换个没装插件的 profile、或用别的工具（Claude Code 等）读 `~/.agents/skills`，都看不到它们 —— 这正是「不跟通用技能混在一起」的代价
- **技能名撞车是静默的**：DSH 的规则是运行时技能压过用户在 `~/.agents/skills` 里的同名技能，被压掉的那份不报错、也不出现在技能列表里。本插件因此只用全新名字（当前只有 `yon-devkit`）
- **技能面板只列部署级技能**：`~/.agents/skills` 里的技能由 DSH 的 agent 预设按会话挂载（进 preset 的作用域层），面板没有会话上下文、命名不出该作用域，因此不列出它们。这是 DSH 的分层设计而非缺陷（详见上文「技能面板怎么用」）
- **技能改动要重启**：`skills/*.md` 属于 host 半数据，改完必须 `pnpm build` + 重启 DSH（刷新页面不够）
- **需求条目与项目记忆都没有删除工具**：模型能建、能改、能追加，删不了。真删只在面板里由人做（需求面板已有；记忆面板排 P1）。这是刻意的——一个能自己删记录的模型，很快就不再是「帮你记事的那一方」
- **项目记忆没有「已验证 / 已过期」这类状态**：记忆说的是**当前事实**，不是「某年某月谁说的」。不成立就用 `memory_update` 改正、或让人删掉，库里只留当前成立的结论。所以**别指望从状态上看出哪条可信**——`source`（出处）是唯一线索，也是写入时的必填项
- **记忆的注入一次会话只给一次，每个项目最多五条**：同一段文字在上下文里重复六遍，模型会学着跳过去，那正好毁掉这段文字存在的理由。要看更多用 `memory_recall`，要读全文用 `memory_read`
- **记忆面板只能看与删**：面板上没有「新建」按钮，也没有编辑框，这是有意的——记忆是模型查出来的事实，凭印象填一条会被下一个会话当成事实用。想让库里多一条，在对话里让模型记；想改一条，也让它改（改会走审批）

## 源码地图

十个面板，每个的形状都一样：`src/client/<X>Item.tsx` 一个内建条目、`src/client/<X>/` 一组界面文件、
`src/host/<X>-*.ts` 一组 host 模块。下面按这层结构列 —— 想找某个文件时，`find src/client src/host -type f` 仍是权威。

### 基础层（十个面板共用）

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host 入口：打开各领域、发布服务、注册自带技能、挂 `/yon/api` |
| `src/host/tools.ts` | 工具注册表，以及跟随会话权限档的写操作闸门（拒绝 / 直写 / 确认） |
| `src/host/http.ts` | `/yon/api` 全部路由与错误映射（没有 web server 的部署下不挂载） |
| `src/host/prompt.ts` | 注入给模型的工具说明。**组数是写下来的**，新增一组工具要同步改 |
| `src/shared/types.ts` | 前后端共用的数据契约 |
| `src/client/index.ts` | 浏览器半入口：席位注册、面板 store、**十个**内建条目、API 客户端注入面 |
| `src/client/YonPanelRoot.tsx` | 侧栏底部触发按钮、面板外壳、分层后的关闭行为 |
| `src/client/panel-store.ts` | 面板开合状态 + 覆盖层层数（一次 Esc 只关一层） |
| `src/client/panel.module.css` / `panel-item.module.css` | 十个面板共用的对话框样式 / 十个内建格共用的图标格样式 |
| `src/client/request.ts` | 各 API 客户端共用的 `/yon/api` JSON 调用与错误类型 |
| `src/client/slots.ts` / `locales.ts` / `cn.ts` / `item-rows.ts` | 席位与 inject face 类型 / 词典（**zh 与 en 两份**）/ 类名拼接 / 条目行 |
| `scripts/build-skills.mjs` | 把 `skills/*/SKILL.md` 内联成 TS；`--check` 用来抓漂移 |
| `skills/<名字>/SKILL.md` | 插件自带技能的**源文件**（普通技能 bundle，你编辑这个） |

### 十个面板

| 面板 | 界面（`src/client/`） | host 半（`src/host/`） | 职责 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 项目 `project` | `project/{ProjectManager,FieldTable,InlineText,CreateProjectDialog}.tsx`、`useComposing.ts`、`api.ts` | `domain.ts`、`service.ts` | 项目与动态字段：主子表聚合、级联删除、写入校验、按 id/名称/编码定位；`tools.ts` 另有 5 个 `project_*` 工具 |
| 技能 `skill` | `skill/{SkillManager.tsx,api.ts}` | `skill-domain.ts`、`skill-registry.ts`、`skill-catalog.ts`、`skill-catalog.generated.ts` | 自带技能的注册 / 注销 / 开关；`.generated.ts` 是**生成物**（已提交、勿手改） |
| 数据源 `datasource` | `datasource/{DataSourceManager.tsx,api.ts,panel.module.css}` | `datasource-store.ts`、`datasource-service.ts`、`datasource-probe.ts`、`datasource-catalog.ts`、`datasource-tools.ts` | 数据源登记与 SQL 取数：探测交给随包的脚本跑，密码只以 `hasPassword` 进视图 |
| 安装目录 `home` | `home/{HomeManager.tsx,api.ts,panel.module.css}` | `home-store.ts`、`home-probe.ts`、`home-mirror.ts`、`home-service.ts`、`home-tools.ts`、`home-files.ts` | 登记本机 NCC/BIP Home，探测它是什么（不打开 jar）、镜像回技能侧；`home-files.ts` 管包含性检查、编码与凭据打码 |
| 知识库 `wiki` | `wiki/{WikiManager.tsx,api.ts,panel.module.css}` | `wiki-store.ts`、`wiki-index.ts`、`wiki-graph.ts`、`wiki-usage.ts`、`wiki-service.ts`、`wiki-tools.ts`、`wiki-write.ts` | 页与页之间的引用图、被问过什么 / 答不上什么的日志。两条写入路径互不相干：**页**走 `wiki-write.ts`（三种模式，不能覆盖已有页），**登记**（`wiki-service.ts` 的 `saveVault`/`removeVault`，面板的三个动词）只改 `wiki_config.json`，不写页也不在 vault 里删东西 |
| 消化 `digest` | `digest/{DigestManager.tsx,api.ts,panel.module.css}` | `digest-log.ts`、`digest-audit.ts`、`digest-plan.ts`、`digest-sweep.ts`、`digest-config.ts`、`digest-tools.ts` | 判断一份「源素材 → 知识页」消化得够不够：配置阈值与词表、批量按源文档分组验收、每次验收留一条流水 |
| 迭代 `iteration` | `iteration/{IterationManager.tsx,api.ts,panel.module.css}` | `iteration-store.ts`、`iteration-service.ts`、`iteration-tools.ts` | 模型在使用这套插件时记下的短板（能力不足 / 优化建议）与使用者的处理（状态 / 优先级 / 删除）。模型**只能追加**（`iteration_add` / `iteration_list`，没有改与删的工具），改状态、调优先级、删除都在面板里由人做；台账在 `~/.dsh/yon-panel/iteration.json`。设计记录见 `docs/yon-iteration-design.md` |
| 浏览器 `browser` | `browser/{BrowserManager.tsx,api.ts,panel.module.css}` | `browser-scan.ts`、`browser-store.ts`、`browser-system.ts`、`browser-service.ts` | **调试浏览器**：扫一遍本机（Chrome / Edge / Chromium / Firefox）并记住路径，填端口点「启动」起一个带调试端口的浏览器，面板报出连接地址，能停掉**本面板起过**的实例。全仓唯一一处 `node:child_process`（进程必须活过这次调用并活过 DSH 重启），也是唯一会结束进程的面板；登记在 `~/.dsh/yon-panel/browser_config.json`、台账在 `browser_runs.json`，用户数据目录默认在插件根目录的 `.browser-profile/<id>/`。设计记录见 `docs/yon-browser-design.md` |
| 需求 `requirement` | `requirement/{RequirementManager.tsx,api.ts,panel.module.css}` | `requirement-doc.ts`、`requirement-store.ts`、`requirement-files.ts`、`requirement-service.ts`、`requirement-tools.ts` | 某个项目下「要做的事」：名称 / 状态 / 正文 + 一段段追加的标注（删除线即历史，模型读到的是去掉删除线的那份）+ 三个文件夹（`user/` 使用者给的原件、`generated/` 模型的方案、`patches/` 补丁）。**正文只放使用者要什么，模型探查出来的进标注**——这条分界只有提示词那一段守得住。设计记录见 `docs/yon-requirement-design.md` |
| 记忆 `memory` | `memory/{MemoryManager.tsx,api.ts,panel.module.css}` | `memory-doc.ts`、`memory-store.ts`、`memory-service.ts`、`memory-tools.ts` | **项目记忆**：某个项目上已经摸出来的坑、环境事实、决定与偏好，由模型写、下一个会话自动带回来。这一屏与其余九格**相反：只有看与删**，没有新建也没有修改——记忆是「某人查出来的事实」，做成一张表填写就等于允许凭印象编一条，而库里每一条都会被注入到下一个会话里当成事实用。行上给类型徽标、标题、项目与日期，展开读全文（正文、出处、id），删除要两次点击。设计记录见 `docs/yon-memory-design.md` |

### 不属于任何面板的读取层

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `src/host/class-index.ts` / `class-tools.ts` | 类索引：走一遍安装目录、从每个 `.jar` 里读类名，然后按类名查它在哪个 jar |
| `src/host/meta-bmf.ts` / `meta-index.ts` / `meta-service.ts` / `meta-tools.ts` | NCC 元数据：把 `modules/*/METADATA/*.bmf` 压平成可查的索引 |
| `src/host/bip-meta.ts` / `bip-meta-tools.ts` | 旗舰版元数据：解析随包的快照，进程内缓存，不建索引 |
| `src/host/knowledge-tools.ts` | 随包参考文档的检索 |
| `src/host/gbk-tool.ts` | GBK 源码文件的读与改 |

### 项目记忆的落盘层（第十格背后）

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `src/host/memory-doc.ts` | 一条记忆的文本层：frontmatter 与正文的解析 / 序列化。纯函数，无文件系统、无时钟 |
| `src/host/memory-store.ts` | `memory/` 的磁盘层：`index.json` + 每条一个 `<id>.md`。原子写、`isSafeId` 门、坏记录跳过而不是让整份索引读不出来 |
| `src/host/memory-service.ts` | id 生成（`mem-<本地日期>-<本地时分秒>-<随机>`）、字段校验、项目解析、同项目同标题去重、读改写队列、删除、体检 |
| `src/host/memory-sweep.ts` | 体检的六项检查（索引落后、孤儿、无出处、超长、两两像同一件事、久未复核）与 `repair`（**只重建 `index.json`**，不碰任何 `.md`） |
| `src/host/memory-session.ts` | 「本次会话现在在哪个项目上」的登记处，以及那一行计数提示怎么并进别的工具的结果里 |
| `src/host/memory-tools.ts` | `memory_write` / `memory_update` / `memory_recall` / `memory_read` / `memory_sweep` |
| `src/host/tools.ts`（改动） | `project_read` 的返回值里带上这个项目最近的五条（只给标题与 id，一次会话一次）；`isDestructiveWrite` 认 `memory_update` |
| `scripts/verify-memory-live.mjs` | 实机验证：跑编译产物走一遍完整闭环，并把产出的一份 `.md` 打印出来（形态错了要在这儿看得见） |

**面板不做写**：写入与改写都在上面这四个 host 模块的模型工具里，面板只有 `list` / `read` / `remove` 三个调用（`GET` 与 `DELETE`，没有 `POST` 也没有 `PATCH`）。这条不对称是本功能的设计，不是还没做完——`memory-panel.client.spec.tsx` 与 `http-memory.spec.ts` 各有一条用例盯着它。详见 [`docs/yon-memory-design.md`](docs/yon-memory-design.md)。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-session-menu **English** | [中文](README.zh.md) Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete to the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) sidebar session menu — plus status dots, hover-card details and one-click delete for archived rows. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-session-menu?label=npm&color=%234D6BFE)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-menu) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-%234D6BFE)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2-%234D6BFE)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [UI](#ui) · [Install](#install) · [Uninstall](#uninstall) · [Configuration](#configuration)
## UI | Session menu | Status dots | |---|---| | ![session menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu/main/assets/02-menu.en.png) | ![status dots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu/main/assets/01-states.en.png) | | Hover card | Archived rows: one-click delete + bulk entry | |---|---| | ![hover card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu/main/assets/05-hover.en.png) | ![bulk delete](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu/main/assets/06-bulk.en.png) | | Delete confirmation | Archived row menu | |---|---| | ![delete](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu/main/assets/03-delete.en.png) | ![archived row](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu/main/assets/04-row.en.png) | Once installed, it looks like this under **Settings → Plugins → Installed**: ![In the plugin list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu/main/assets/07-plugin.en.png) ## Install All three ways install the `dsh-session-menu` package from npm. ### Option 1 — install it inside DSH (recommended) 1. Open DSH and click **Plugins** in the left sidebar 2. Click **Add plugin** in the top right 3. Type `dsh-session-menu` and click **Install** 4. **Restart the DSH app** ### Option 2 — let the Agent install it Send this to the Agent inside DSH: ``` Install the plugin dsh-session-menu with the plugin manager, then remind me to restart DSH. ``` ### Option 3 — install it from the terminal If you are comfortable with a command line: open macOS's **Terminal** app (`⌘ + Space`, search "Terminal"), paste this line and press Enter. ```sh dsh plugin add dsh-session-menu ``` Either way, **restart the DSH app** afterwards. ## Uninstall **Settings → Plugins → Installed**, click the trash icon on the `dsh-session-menu` row and confirm. ## Configuration The apps inside the **Open with ›** submenu are configurable. Add a block to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml config: applications: - kind: editor paths: - /Applications/Visual Studio Code.app - kind: terminal paths: - /System/Applications/Utilities/Terminal.app ``` Each entry takes the **first path that exists**, and only the matching one shows up in the menu. `config` **replaces the whole list**, it does not append. Restart DSH after editing. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt: --- description: "Read, annotate and revise Markdown manuscripts in DSH with AI proposals, word-level diffs and persistent review baselines." kind: "package-bundle" --- # DSH Article Review English | [中文](README.zh.md) Read, annotate and revise Markdown manuscripts alongside your [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) conversation. AI submits revision proposals; you inspect the changes, accept or reject them, or request another revision. Across multiple revision rounds, each paragraph stays compared with **the last version you marked reviewed**, so you can see what still needs your attention. ![Review an AI proposal with rendered and source differences](docs/screenshots/review-proposal.png) *Screenshots use fictional manuscripts; proposals include real model runs.* ## Features - **Read and annotate** — highlights, underlines, comments and manuscript search. - **Revise with AI** — propose replacements, insertions or deletions; revise pending proposals. Supports headings, lists and tables. - **Track your review** — mark and lock reviewed paragraphs; track later changes. - **Compare versions** — word-level comparisons and exact Markdown source diffs. - **Review figures** — preview and propose replacements; keep before/after copies. - **Preview companion documents** — open the manuscript or workspace files in DSH’s native preview alongside the review. - **Manage references** — bind BibTeX, jump to citations and check new citation keys. ## Install Supports DSH Web `0.2.1-alpha.4` and Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`. Uses your existing model configuration. ### Desktop App The App includes its runtime; no separate Node installation is needed. 1. Open **Plugins** in the App's left sidebar, then click **Add plugin**. 2. Paste the npm package name and version: `dsh-article-review@0.2.1-alpha.2` 3. After installation, click **Enable now** and follow any restart prompt. 4. Choose a local workspace and open a conversation. In the right sidebar, choose **Read, annotate and revise**. 5. Click **Browse workspace → Choose local file** to open a Markdown manuscript. The system dialog belongs to the App; the selected file must be inside this conversation's workspace. BibTeX and replacement figures use the same Desktop picker. Desktop uses its own `desktop` profile. Installing into the `web` profile does not install into the App. If you previously installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-paper-review` from GitHub, uninstall that package in Plugins before installing the npm package above and restarting. Workspace review records in `.paper-review/` continue to be used. macOS Desktop has been exercised; see [platform requirements](docs/development.md#scope-and-compatibility) for Windows. Choose the official npm registry or the mainland China mirror. If the mirror has not synced this version, use the official registry. GitHub installation is also available as `github:Biogod2020/dsh-article-review#v0.2.1-alpha.2`. If GitHub times out, download the [prebuilt release archive](https://codeload.github.com/Biogod2020/dsh-article-review/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.2.1-alpha.2) and enter its absolute local path in **Plugins → Add plugin**, without extracting or building it. Tags through `v0.2.1-alpha.1` retain the old package name; install one package name at a time. ### Web Requires Node.js 22 (≥22.19) or 24+: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add 'dsh-article-review@0.2.1-alpha.2' dsh web ``` Restart a running Web profile after installation. For GitHub installation, use the prebuilt tag; `main` contains development source. ## Start reviewing 1. Choose **Read, annotate and revise** in the right sidebar and open a Markdown manuscript. 2. Select text, annotate it, attach the notes to the conversation and send your request. 3. In **Review changes**, accept, reject or request a revision; check the result and mark it reviewed. Accepting updates the manuscript and keeps your review baseline. Back up `.paper-review/` with the manuscript and exclude it from public Git history. Paragraph locks apply within this plugin. ## Screenshots Select text and right-click to highlight or annotate. ![Selection actions](docs/screenshots/select-text.png) Save annotations and attach revision requests to the conversation. ![Annotations and highlights](docs/screenshots/annotate.png) Check review progress and jump to sections or paragraphs. ![Review progress and navigation](docs/screenshots/review-outline.jpg) Compare two versions and see changed words directly. ![Version comparison](docs/screenshots/versions-rendered.jpg) Preview PDFs, review figure replacements and browse references. ![PDF preview](docs/screenshots/figure-pdf.jpg) ![Figure replacement](docs/screenshots/figure-replacement.jpg) ![Reference browser](docs/screenshots/references.jpg) Compact reading on narrow screens. ## Documentation - [User guide](docs/user-guide.md) — operations and configuration. - [Development and compatibility](docs/development.md) — builds, tools and persistence. Edit Markdown manuscripts; figures support images and PDFs. See [other formats and platforms](docs/development.md#scope-and-compatibility). [MIT License](LICENSE)

# dsh-sticky-notes-desktop

[中文](README.zh.md) | **English**

Desktop sticky notes and screenshot annotation for **DeepSeek Harness**. The notes are **real, always-on-top OS windows** — switching to another app or minimising DSH will not cover them.

- **Hotkey notes** — a hotkey pops up a "new note / screenshot" menu at the mouse. Notes drag and resize freely, and snap to a screen edge and tuck themselves away when you drop them near one.
- **They come back** — position and hidden state are saved as you work, so closing and reopening DSH returns every note (including hidden ones) to where it was.
- **Note alarms** — set a note to appear on top at a time you choose: every day, on weekdays, or once.
- **Ask for one in conversation** — `sticky_notes_*` tools let the model create, read, move, hide and delete notes, and set alarms.

---

## The UI

The sidebar entry reads **便签**; the panel has two tabs, **便签** / **便签闹钟**:

![The notes panel](docs/panel-with-note.png)

"Settings → **便签设置**" is its own page — hotkey recording, colours, opacity, font size, snap and hide behaviour, service status, with a live preview:

![Sticky-notes settings](docs/settings.png)

## 便签闹钟 (note alarms)

"At a given time, put this in front of me." Switch the panel to the **便签闹钟** tab.

![An alarm popup](docs/alarm-text.png)

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Content | **Text** or an **image** (chosen with the system file dialog; png/jpg/gif/webp/bmp) |
| Every day | `HH:MM` daily |
| Weekdays | `HH:MM` Monday–Friday |
| One time | A specific date and time, **fires once** |
| Row buttons | Test / Edit / Enable-disable / Delete, plus "Stop ringing" while it is ringing |
| **Position** | Defaults to **dead centre**; press **Test**, drag the popup where you want it, and the position is remembered |

**Behaviour**

- It takes no screen space until the moment arrives, then shows an **always-on-top window** with your text or image.
- Press 关闭, hit `Esc`, or right-click the window to end that reminder.
- One alarm, one window — two firing at once do not close each other.
- **A missed alarm still rings.** If DSH was not running when it came due, the next start fires it immediately. An alarm may be late, but it must not vanish silently.
- It fires at most once per minute, so polling cannot produce duplicates.
- The popup is transient and never "restored": closing it means it is gone.

### Choosing where it appears

**Test doubles as the position picker:**

1. Press **Test** in the editor (**available before you save**, too);
2. **Drag** the popup where you want it;
3. Close it — the editor's "position" shows the coordinates you left it at;
4. Save. That alarm now appears there.

"Reset position" returns it to the centre.

> Test does not consume an alarm: it never writes `lastFiredAt`, so a one-time alarm **still fires at its appointed moment**. Testing an unsaved alarm writes nothing at all.
>
> A saved position that falls on a screen that no longer exists (an unplugged monitor, a changed resolution) is clamped back into view when the alarm fires — otherwise it would appear somewhere invisible and could not be dismissed.

## Installation

Install through DSH's plugin manager (`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`).

**From this repository**

```
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="<absolute path to this checkout>")
```

The path **must be absolute** (relative paths are refused). A local directory is recorded as a `link:`, so editing the code and restarting DSH is enough — useful while developing.

**From a packed tarball**

```bash
npm pack    # produces dsh-sticky-notes-desktop-0.1.0.tgz
```

```
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="<absolute path to the .tgz>")
```

The tarball is copied into the profile rather than linked, so it works on other machines.

**From npm**

```
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="dsh-sticky-notes-desktop")
```

The package is [`dsh-sticky-notes-desktop`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-sticky-notes-desktop) — the easiest route, since it needs neither a clone nor a local `npm pack`.

Then **restart DSH**: a profile's bundle list is only read at startup.

> `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` is managed exclusively by the Electron application, and `dsh --profile desktop` is refused. Install through the in-app plugin manager, or edit that profile's `package.json` directly.

### Notes on installing

| | |
|---|---|
| The only required manifest field | `dsh.bundle.patch` — that single field is DSH's whole "is this a bundle?" test |
| Accepted `target` forms | An absolute directory, an absolute `.tgz` (local or over http), a git URL, or an npm package name. **Relative paths are refused.** |
| The browser half must be pre-built | DSH does not build at install time. `npm pack` runs a `prepack` check that the shipped bundle is current. |
| `files` matters for `.tgz`/npm only | A `link:` install symlinks the source directory, so missing files there fail only for everyone else. A test guards it. |

## First run

The default hotkey **Ctrl + Alt + S** pops up a menu at the mouse; choose "new note" or "screenshot".

The default note is **black at 80% opacity with light text** (`#000000` / `0.8` / `#f5f5f5`):

![The default black note](docs/note-black.png)

Colour, opacity and text colour are changed in "Settings → 便签设置"; changing the text colour automatically re-colours every foreground element.

---

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Action | Key |
|---|---|
| Open the menu | `Ctrl+Alt+S` by default; any combination can be set in settings |
| Screenshot: confirm the selection / save the image | `Enter` |
| Screenshot: save as a note | `Ctrl+Enter` |
| Screenshot: copy to the clipboard | `Ctrl+C` |
| Screenshot: undo / redo | `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Shift+Z` |
| Screenshot: select the whole screen / cancel | `Ctrl+A` / `Esc` |
| Note: save a draft | `Ctrl+S` |

The hotkey is **system-wide** (Electron `globalShortcut`), so it fires even when DSH is not in the foreground.

### A taken hotkey is reported, never silently replaced

The default is **`Ctrl+Alt+S`**, and what gets registered is **always exactly the combination you set**. Quietly substituting another key would mean you press the right combination and nothing happens, so instead the conflict is stated plainly and you decide what to change.

When there is a conflict you will see it in three places: a **red banner at the top of "Settings → 便签设置"** naming the taken combination, the **notes panel's footer turning red**, and a red notice inline the moment you record a conflicting combination.

`Ctrl+Alt+S` is heavily contested — Windows 11's Snipping Tool and various screen recorders claim it. `Ctrl+Shift+S`, `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+S` and `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N` are usually free.

## A note created with the hotkey is a draft

A note created with the hotkey **enters the list only after you press Save**:

- The title bar shows an **`未保存`** badge until you save;
- Anything you type lives only in that window and is **never written to `data.json`**;
- **Closing (or deleting) it outright leaves nothing behind** — no row appears in the list;
- Pressing Save (or `Ctrl+S`) makes it appear in the sidebar list immediately, after which every edit is saved automatically.

> "Close" means different things for the two kinds of note: for a **saved** note it just puts the window away and the content stays in the list; for a **draft** it discards it.
>
> "New note" from the sidebar list takes a different path — the host creates it directly, so it is **in the list immediately**.

## Edge snapping / auto-hide

- Drag a note within 12px of a screen edge and it snaps to it (the distance is configurable).
- After a brief pause it hides itself. **The default is to move the whole note off-screen**, leaving a 1px sliver at the edge.
- Push the mouse against that edge (after 120ms by default) and the note slides back; move the mouse away and it hides again.
- While hidden the window is **click-through**, so it does not block what is underneath it.

> The 1px sliver is deliberate rather than 0: a window moved fully off-screen can only be recalled by moving the pointer to a spot where nothing is drawn. One pixel is invisible but keeps the edge hittable.

### "保留" (keep out)

The note's title bar has a **`保留`** button:

- Press it → it becomes **`取消保留`** (highlighted), and that note **no longer snaps and never auto-hides** — it stays where you put it;
- Press it again → normal behaviour returns.

The state is saved in `data.json` and survives a restart. The sidebar list offers the same button.

## Screenshots and annotation

Drag out a region, then draw rectangles, ellipses and arrows, use a freehand pen, and type text; 8 colours, 3 line weights, undo / redo / clear. Three exits:

| Button | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| **Save image** | Opens the system **save dialog** so you choose the location and filename; cancelling keeps you in the editor |
| **Save as note** | Becomes an **always-on-top** screenshot note **at the position you selected**, exactly like a hand-made note |
| **Copy** | Writes to the system clipboard |

What gets exported is the **clean selected region** — the dimming mask, toolbar and size label never bleed in.

## Data

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `~/.dsh/sticky-notes/data.json` | Note index + alarms + settings |
| `~/.dsh/sticky-notes/shots/<id>.png` | Pixels for screenshot notes |
| `~/.dsh/sticky-notes/shot-notes/shot-*.png` | Images from "save as note" |
| `~/.dsh/sticky-notes/helper.lock` | Pid of the process holding the helper |
| `~/.dsh/sticky-notes/electron-runtime/` | A self-provided Electron runtime, if any |

The index is written **atomically** (temp file + rename); a corrupt file is renamed aside and rebuilt rather than preventing the plugin from loading.

## Service status (Settings → 便签设置)

At the top of the settings page is a **便签服务** status answering "can it actually pop a window right now?":

| Display | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 🟢 **正在运行** | The process is up **and actually answered** — with the display count, active hotkey, PID and Electron path |
| 🟡 **无响应** | The process exists but no longer answers — typically a stale process after a plugin upgrade. **Press 重启服务** |
| 🔴 **未运行** | Not running, or it failed to start (the reason is printed) |

Buttons: **启动服务** / **重启服务** / **停止服务** / **刷新状态**.

> The status is not "the host remembers starting it" but **a question actually asked of it**. The two differ exactly when things go wrong: a wedged helper still looks healthy to the host, and fixing that is why "restart" exists — so that case must read **无响应**, not **正在运行**.

## Settings

| Setting | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Hotkey | Click, then press a combination to record it; at least one modifier |
| Background / text colour | 8 presets plus a colour picker |
| Opacity | 20%–100%, with a live preview |
| Font size | 8–72px |
| **Hide style** | **Move off-screen (default) / edge tab** |
| Snap distance | How close to an edge counts as snapping |
| Auto-hide delay | How long a snapped note waits before hiding |
| Reveal delay | How long after the mouse reaches the edge the note slides back |
| Start with DSH | When off, the helper is no longer launched automatically |

> A note window **has no colour button of its own**: colour is a preference, and preferences live in one place — 便签设置. The title bar carries only Save / Keep out / Close / Delete (screenshot notes add "Save as").

## For the model

The plugin gives the model a documented surface rather than leaving it to improvise. Twelve tools, one per operation:

`sticky_notes_list` · `sticky_notes_create` · `sticky_notes_read` · `sticky_notes_update` ·
`sticky_notes_delete` · `sticky_notes_show` · `sticky_notes_hide` ·
`sticky_notes_alarm_list` · `sticky_notes_alarm_set` · `sticky_notes_alarm_delete` ·
`sticky_notes_alarm_ring` · `sticky_notes_screenshot`

Alongside them, a **system-prompt section** (always present, so the model does not reach for a shell when asked for a note) and a **`sticky-notes` skill** carrying the longer workflows.

## Troubleshooting

**The hotkey does nothing.** In order of likelihood:

1. **DSH has not been restarted.** Both the host half and the helper are loaded at startup, and the helper keeps running old code until then.
2. **Another application owns the combination.** Look for the red banner in "Settings → 便签设置"; the notes panel's footer also turns red. Record another combination under "open menu".
3. **The helper did not start.** The banner on the 便签设置 page states the reason:
   - *Electron runtime not found* → the first run downloads ~120MB; check your network, or point `DSH_STICKY_NOTES_ELECTRON` at an existing Electron executable.
   - *Another sticky-notes helper is using the same data directory* → another DSH instance is open; close it first.

**The popup does not disappear when clicking outside.** It closes when you pick an item, press `Esc`, or move the mouse away — "clicking outside" works because the popup gets out of the way and the click lands where you meant.

**Note windows do not appear.** See item 3 above; also check that "start with DSH" has not been turned off.

**The model ignores the plugin and does everything with a shell.** It cannot see the tools, which means the plugin did not register them — check that the `sticky_notes_*` tools appear in the session's tool list, and restart DSH.

**Degraded behaviour.** When the helper cannot start, neither the plugin nor DSH crashes: the note list, editing, deleting and settings all keep working, and only the always-on-top windows are unavailable.

## Known limitations

- **One DSH instance at a time**: the helper locks per data directory, so a second instance reports the conflict explicitly instead of popping up duplicate windows.
- **A screenshot covers only the display the mouse is on**: with multiple monitors, position the pointer on the target screen first.
- **`hiddenRevealWidth` is deprecated**: the tab is a fixed 36px, bounded below by the platform's minimum window width.

## License

MIT
