# DeepSeekBot [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/deepseekbot?color=CB3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/website-deepseekbot.app-3D5AFE)](https://deepseekbot.app/en/) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot?style=flat&logo=github)](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) **DeepSeekBot (DSB): the open-source Grok Bot alternative for DeepSeek Harness.** A crew of bots, each with its own identity, persona and memory, working together. [Website](https://deepseekbot.app/en/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [Docs](https://botharness.ai) · [中文](#中文)
DeepSeekBot installs into [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as one plugin: a Bot roster, DMs and Groups, Git Memory you can see, delegation, and IM identities of the Bots' own. DeepSeekBot (DSB) is a different project from DS Bot (npm `ds-bot`); see [how they differ](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/README.en.md#deepseek-bot-projects). - **Open-source Grok Bot alternative**, MIT licensed - **Built on DeepSeek Harness**: any model provider you connect in DSH works - **Works with other DSH plugins** in the same Profile - **Lark / Feishu, Slack, Discord, QQ and WeChat**: Bots speak under their own identity ## Install **Desktop:** in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, go to **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `deepseekbot`, keep the official npm registry and click **Install**, then **Enable now**. **Bot mode** appears in the sidebar. **CLI:** needs Node 22+ and DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. ```bash npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile web add deepseekbot dsh web ``` Open **Bot mode**, create a PersonaBot, DM it, then start a Group and invite members. To use Lark, Slack, Discord, QQ or WeChat, connect the app in **Settings → IM bots**, then bind the identity and authorize a group in the Bot's Profile. Accounts start disconnected; you turn each one on. ## Every Bot is a colleague - **Lasting identity:** each PersonaBot keeps its own name, Soul (SOUL.md) and avatar across chats, Sessions and Workspaces. - **Git Memory you can see:** a Bot's memory is a plain Git working tree. Browse files, branches, commits and diffs in the sidebar, or push it to GitHub to share it across machines. - **Groups:** messages keep each Bot's identity, and you @ whoever you need. - **Assignments:** grant a Workspace and a Bot can delegate independent Assignments, each with its own Session and report. - **Their own IM identity:** when mentioned in an authorized group or thread, a Bot replies there under its own identity. - **Schedules:** have a Bot do something every few minutes, every hour or every day; add one in the sidebar or just ask the Bot, and lock it when the Bot shouldn't change it. - **Bot Marketplace:** install a Bot someone shared on the [Bot Marketplace](https://deepseekbot.app/en/market), or [share your own](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/docs/share-bot.md). - **Update notes:** after an install or update, Bot mode shows what changed, and Bot settings check npm for a newer version. More screenshots and per-version highlights are in the [GitHub README](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot#screenshots). ## Pixel avatars Every Bot's default avatar is generated from its name, and while a Bot works its avatar morphs into the tool it is using. Try it on the [website](https://deepseekbot.app/en/avatar); avatars come from [BotPixel](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotPixel). ## Built on DeepSeek Harness DeepSeekBot runs on DSH's own session management and harness, so any LLM provider you connect in DSH works for your Bots, and it installs alongside other DSH plugins. Some plugins may not be compatible yet; please open an [issue](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues) or a PR if you hit one. ## Community - Discord: [discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) - QQ group: 1125565676 - Issues: [github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues) --- ## 中文 **DeepSeekBot（DSB）：开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** DeepSeekBot 以一个插件装进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：Bot 名册、私聊与 Group、看得见的 Git Memory、定时任务、Bot 市场、任务委派，以及 Bot 自己的 IM 身份（飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、QQ、微信）。DeepSeekBot（简称 DSB）与 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见 [GitHub README](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot#deepseek-bot-projects)。它直接用 DSH 的 Session 管理和 Harness，你在 DSH 里接入的任何模型 provider 都能用，也能和其他 DSH 插件装在一起。 **桌面端**：打开 DeepSeek Harness，点「插件 → 添加插件」，在「包名或地址」里输入 `deepseekbot`，点「安装」，再点「立即启用」。 **命令行**： ```bash npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile web add deepseekbot dsh web ``` 更多截图和各版本亮点见 [GitHub README](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/README.md#screenshots)。 官网：[deepseekbot.app](https://deepseekbot.app) · 源码：[GitHub](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · Discord：[加入](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) · QQ 群：1125565676 --- ## Package notes This product Bundle combines BotHarness Core (`@botharness/core`), Client (`@botharness/ui`), Browser (`@botharness/browser`), Computer (`@botharness/computer`) and the independently versioned, qualified IM Provider (`@botharness/im-provider`, maintained from [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) under its MIT license). The Provider updates with the product, without an independent upstream auto-update. Browser and Computer ship present but gated: each Bot still needs its own Browser/Computer Access, and IM accounts start disconnected until you add app credentials in Settings → IM bots. If an existing Profile enables standalone `@xmanrui/dsh-im` or `@botharness/im-provider` as another Bundle, remove that separate Bundle before enabling DeepSeekBot. Formerly separate `@botharness/browser`, `@botharness/computer`, `@botharness/core` or `@botharness/ui` entries migrate into this Bundle automatically on update. Removing a Bundle keeps its stored account configuration and credentials; revalidate the retained Bot bindings and group authorization afterwards. The Bot Browser runs headless by default; a Host that needs the visible window (one-time Human login) overrides `headless` in a later Patch layer or Settings. MIT © BotHarness
# DeepSeekBot **中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/deepseekbot?color=CB3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) [![官网](https://img.shields.io/badge/官网-deepseekbot.app-3D5AFE)](https://deepseekbot.app) [![MIT 许可](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-加入-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) [![QQ 群：1125565676](https://img.shields.io/badge/QQ-1125565676-12B7F5)](#community) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot?style=flat)](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) **DeepSeekBot（DSB）：开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** [官网](https://deepseekbot.app) · [宣传片](#video) · [安装](#install) · [能力](#features) · [版本亮点](#releases) · [与 DS Bot 的区别](#deepseek-bot-projects) · [社区](#community) · [文档](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/overview/)
## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 DeepSeekBot：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。点击封面即可播放。

DeepSeekBot（简称 **DSB**，是 DeepSeekBot 的缩写，才不是“大啥比”，哼）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端点「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `deepseekbot@1.3.1`，安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | DeepSeekBot 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://deepseekbot.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://deepseekbot.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 名册与私聊：每个 Bot 有自己的像素头像；右侧是它的记忆演化。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。
_截图来自隔离的本地 DSH，对话是虚构的天文台展览示例。_ ## 看得见的记忆 每个 Bot 的记忆就是一个普通的 Git 仓库。你可以在侧栏翻看它记了什么、哪天改了哪几行，觉得不对就直接改；推到 GitHub，就能在几台电脑之间共用同一个 Bot。详见[记忆演化指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/)。 ## 版本亮点 完整记录见[官网更新日志](https://deepseekbot.app/changelog/)。 | 版本 | 新内容 | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **[1.3.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.3.1)**（2026-10-14） | 从插件页安装 `deepseekbot` 重新只要一步，不再要求批准构建；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。`deepseekbot` 命令行可以配置 Host、操作 Bot 的浏览器和 Computer、管理 IM 应用；浏览器面板实时刷新。 | | **[1.3.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.3.0)**（2026-10-14） | 界面换上统一的设计系统，Channel 设置收进对话框；Orchestrator 自己整理收件箱和任务；Bot 可以凭你批准使用密钥跑命令行和 **MCP**，一句话就能配好 MCP；消息可多选**导出**；新增 Bot 主题色、更多像素物种和自绘部件；记忆可回到任意版本。需要 DSH 0.2.0 及以上。 | | **[1.2.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.2.1)**（2026-10-12） | 修复部分 DSH 版本装不上的问题；群头像显示成员头像拼图；音频和文件附件可以直接播放、下载。 | | **[1.2.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.zh.md#120---2026-10-08)**（2026-10-08） | 可以置顶在桌面的像素**窗口伙伴**；绑定一个应用就能在飞书、Slack、Discord、微信里收发消息；Bot 可以**导入导出**成 zip；Bot 资料页加了横幅和简介。 | | **1.1.0**（2026-10-06） | **定时任务**；每次对话都带上 Bot 的人格和核心记忆；设置里**一键更新**；微信支持语音转文字和图片。 | | **1.0.1**（2026-10-05） | 首个正式版：有身份的 PersonaBots、Git 记忆、群聊、任务委派、像素头像、IM 接入和首版 **Bot 市场**。 | ## DeepSeekBot（DSB）与 DS Bot（ds-bot）：两个项目，不同重心 名字很像，但这是两个独立的开源项目：都运行在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）上，都不是 DeepSeek 公司官方产品。 - **DeepSeekBot（DSB）**，即本仓库，由 BotHarness 维护：让每个 Bot 成为一位能**走出 DSH 窗口**的长期同事。重心是可审阅的 Git 记忆、Bot 自己的飞书 / Slack / Discord / 微信身份、定时任务、任务委派和 Bot 市场。 - **DS Bot**，即 [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)（npm `ds-bot`，项目 README 中也写作 DeepSeek Bot）：把 **DSH 本身变成一个 Bot 聊天应用**。重心是由主 Bot「Chief」通过对话带你建好团队、群管理员默认统筹回复以控制 token 消耗，以及按时间、Bot 和模型查看用量。 | | DeepSeekBot（DSB） | DS Bot（ds-bot） | | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | | 仓库 | [BotHarness/DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) | [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) | | 安装包 | npm [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) | npm [`ds-bot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-bot) | | 许可 | MIT | Apache-2.0 | | 记忆 | 每个 Bot 一个 Git 工作树：文件、commit、diff，可推到 GitHub 在多台机器共享 | Markdown 记忆，每轮后自动审查；个人与团队两级 | | 多 Bot 协作 | Group 中需要谁就 @ 谁；Assignments 委派独立任务并保留报告 | 主 Bot 管理团队；群管理员默认回复，再按需叫其他 Bot | | DSH 之外 | Bot 以自己的身份进入飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、微信 | 提供 GitHub connector | | 其他 | 定时任务、Bot 市场、Bot 导入导出、像素头像 | 定时任务、Usage 用量页 | **怎么选**：想让 Bot 在 IM 里以自己的身份工作、想用 Git 审阅和同步记忆，试试 DeepSeekBot；想在 DSH 里由主 Bot 一步步带着建团队、关注 token 用量，试试 DS Bot。两者都开源，欢迎都去读读源码：[DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)。更详细的对比见[官网文章](https://deepseekbot.app/blog/deepseekbot-vs-ds-bot/)。 ## 常见问题 ### 这是哪个 DeepSeek Bot 项目？ 这里是 **BotHarness 的 DeepSeekBot（DSB）**：安装包为 [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot)，官网为 [deepseekbot.app](https://deepseekbot.app)。DS Bot 使用 `ds-bot`，是另一个独立项目，不是本产品的简称或旧版本，区别见[上文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ### DeepSeekBot 只能使用 DeepSeek 模型吗？ 不是。它使用 DSH 中配置的模型提供商；能否接入取决于接口支持、模型配置与凭据。Bot 的记忆和聊天记录保存在自己的宿主，调用远程模型时相关上下文仍会发给所选服务商。 ## 开发者 想从源码运行或参与开发：需要 Node ≥22 和 pnpm。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot.git BotHarness cd BotHarness pnpm install && pnpm build node scripts/dev-instance.mjs --home /tmp/botharness-demo --port 31967 ``` 更多见[本地实例指南](docs/client-bridge.md#7-本地开发环路dsh-020-rc1) · [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [架构](docs/architecture/botharness-architecture.md) · [架构决策](docs/adr/) · [Agent 开发规范](AGENTS.md) · [Release Ledger](CHANGELOG.zh.md) · [DSH 官方文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)。 真实 IM 测试可用[共享 QA 应用向导](docs/agents/im-test-apps.md)配置 Lark、Slack、Discord 的独立 QA1／QA2／QA3；例如运行 `node scripts/dev-im-test-apps.mjs setup discord`，隐藏输入 Token，并在每次启动接收端前确认当前独占窗口。 ## 社区 问题、想法，还有你做出来的 Bot，都欢迎带来。 - **Discord**：[加入 DeepSeekBot 服务器](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) - **QQ 群**：在 QQ 中搜索群号 **1125565676** - **使用求助、想法与作品分享**：[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions) · [欢迎帖](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1397) - **明确的 Bug 与实施任务**：[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues/new/choose) - **参与维护**：[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [第一次贡献](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1398)，文档、测试和答疑也欢迎。 ## 灵感与致谢 - [Grok Bot](https://x.ai/bot)：持久 Bot，以及像同事一样沟通和委派工作的产品灵感。 - [Rakazo](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo)：持久 AI 队友、对话与记忆体验参考。 - [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)：同样运行在 DSH 上的另一个 Bot 插件，重心不同，值得一读。 - [deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin](https://github.com/loadingvx/deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin)：Memory Git graph 分支线、提交列表与 diff 呈现参考。 - [Coopanion](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion)：窗口伙伴的单气泡对话、逐句节奏、行走朝向与气泡样式参考。 - [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：上游插件宿主。 - [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im)、[dsh-lark-link](https://github.com/amlyczz/dsh-lark-link) 与 [dsh-lark-bridge](https://github.com/imetn/dsh-lark-bridge)：IM 接入基础与可靠性、路由参考。 ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。Client Bundle 中分发的第三方素材见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](packages/client/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 ## Star History **BotHarness/DeepSeekBot** 的实时 Star 历史，使用 [Star History 官方嵌入方式](https://www.star-history.com/blog/how-to-use-github-star-history/#how-to-embed-the-chart-in-your-readme)。

版本亮点 完整记录见[官网更新日志](https://deepseekbot.app/changelog/)。 | 版本 | 新内容 | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **[1.3.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.3.1)**（2026-10-14） | 从插件页安装 `deepseekbot` 重新只要一步，不再要求批准构建；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。`deepseekbot` 命令行可以配置 Host、操作 Bot 的浏览器和 Computer、管理 IM 应用；浏览器面板实时刷新。 | | **[1.3.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.3.0)**（2026-10-14） | 界面换上统一的设计系统，Channel 设置收进对话框；Orchestrator 自己整理收件箱和任务；Bot 可以凭你批准使用密钥跑命令行和 **MCP**，一句话就能配好 MCP；消息可多选**导出**；新增 Bot 主题色、更多像素物种和自绘部件；记忆可回到任意版本。需要 DSH 0.2.0 及以上。 | | **[1.2.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.2.1)**（2026-10-12） | 修复部分 DSH 版本装不上的问题；群头像显示成员头像拼图；音频和文件附件可以直接播放、下载。 | | **[1.2.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.zh.md#120---2026-10-08)**（2026-10-08） | 可以置顶在桌面的像素**窗口伙伴**；绑定一个应用就能在飞书、Slack、Discord、微信里收发消息；Bot 可以**导入导出**成 zip；Bot 资料页加了横幅和简介。 | | **1.1.0**（2026-10-06） | **定时任务**；每次对话都带上 Bot 的人格和核心记忆；设置里**一键更新**；微信支持语音转文字和图片。 | | **1.0.1**（2026-10-05） | 首个正式版：有身份的 PersonaBots、Git 记忆、群聊、任务委派、像素头像、IM 接入和首版 **Bot 市场**。 | ## DeepSeekBot（DSB）与 DS Bot（ds-bot）：两个项目，不同重心 名字很像，但这是两个独立的开源项目：都运行在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）上，都不是 DeepSeek 公司官方产品。 - **DeepSeekBot（DSB）**，即本仓库，由 BotHarness 维护：让每个 Bot 成为一位能**走出 DSH 窗口**的长期同事。重心是可审阅的 Git 记忆、Bot 自己的飞书 / Slack / Discord / 微信身份、定时任务、任务委派和 Bot 市场。 - **DS Bot**，即 [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)（npm `ds-bot`，项目 README 中也写作 DeepSeek Bot）：把 **DSH 本身变成一个 Bot 聊天应用**。重心是由主 Bot「Chief」通过对话带你建好团队、群管理员默认统筹回复以控制 token 消耗，以及按时间、Bot 和模型查看用量。 | | DeepSeekBot（DSB） | DS Bot（ds-bot） | | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | | 仓库 | [BotHarness/DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) | [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) | | 安装包 | npm [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) | npm [`ds-bot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-bot) | | 许可 | MIT | Apache-2.0 | | 记忆 | 每个 Bot 一个 Git 工作树：文件、commit、diff，可推到 GitHub 在多台机器共享 | Markdown 记忆，每轮后自动审查；个人与团队两级 | | 多 Bot 协作 | Group 中需要谁就 @ 谁；Assignments 委派独立任务并保留报告 | 主 Bot 管理团队；群管理员默认回复，再按需叫其他 Bot | | DSH 之外 | Bot 以自己的身份进入飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、微信 | 提供 GitHub connector | | 其他 | 定时任务、Bot 市场、Bot 导入导出、像素头像 | 定时任务、Usage 用量页 | **怎么选**：想让 Bot 在 IM 里以自己的身份工作、想用 Git 审阅和同步记忆，试试 DeepSeekBot；想在 DSH 里由主 Bot 一步步带着建团队、关注 token 用量，试试 DS Bot。两者都开源，欢迎都去读读源码：[DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)。更详细的对比见[官网文章](https://deepseekbot.app/blog/deepseekbot-vs-ds-bot/)。 ## 常见问题 ### 这是哪个 DeepSeek Bot 项目？ 这里是 **BotHarness 的 DeepSeekBot（DSB）**：安装包为 [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot)，官网为 [deepseekbot.app](https://deepseekbot.app)。DS Bot 使用 `ds-bot`，是另一个独立项目，不是本产品的简称或旧版本，区别见[上文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ### DeepSeekBot 只能使用 DeepSeek 模型吗？ 不是。它使用 DSH 中配置的模型提供商；能否接入取决于接口支持、模型配置与凭据。Bot 的记忆和聊天记录保存在自己的宿主，调用远程模型时相关上下文仍会发给所选服务商。 ## 开发者 想从源码运行或参与开发：需要 Node ≥22 和 pnpm。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot.git BotHarness cd BotHarness pnpm install && pnpm build node scripts/dev-instance.mjs --home /tmp/botharness-demo --port 31967 ``` 更多见[本地实例指南](docs/client-bridge.md#7-本地开发环路dsh-020-rc1) · [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [架构](docs/architecture/botharness-architecture.md) · [架构决策](docs/adr/) · [Agent 开发规范](AGENTS.md) · [Release Ledger](CHANGELOG.zh.md) · [DSH 官方文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)。 真实 IM 测试可用[共享 QA 应用向导](docs/agents/im-test-apps.md)配置 Lark、Slack、Discord 的独立 QA1／QA2／QA3；例如运行 `node scripts/dev-im-test-apps.mjs setup discord`，隐藏输入 Token，并在每次启动接收端前确认当前独占窗口。 ## 社区 问题、想法，还有你做出来的 Bot，都欢迎带来。 - **Discord**：[加入 DeepSeekBot 服务器](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) - **QQ 群**：在 QQ 中搜索群号 **1125565676** - **使用求助、想法与作品分享**：[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions) · [欢迎帖](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1397) - **明确的 Bug 与实施任务**：[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues/new/choose) - **参与维护**：[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [第一次贡献](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1398)，文档、测试和答疑也欢迎。 ## evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-clinepass

把 **Cline Pass** 接进 DeepSeek Harness：注册一条 OpenAI 兼容的 pi-ai 路由 `cline-pass`，并做两件事 ——

1. **观察真实 Provider**：只读地看这条路由的聊天响应，读出上游到底是谁（含网关的匿名标签
   `openai-compatible-private`），写进状态文件，供 composer 底部的 **Provider 胶囊**显示；
2. **画用量卡**：设置 → 模型 → Cline Pass 卡片上的 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月用量条。

**它不改写任何请求。** 不碰 body、不碰 headers、不重试、不另发请求；SSE 响应逐帧转发，
不在本地缓冲整包。这是 0.12.0 的形态，也是它和 0.11.x 最大的区别（见「迁移」）。

- 环境要求：**node ≥ 20**，dsh 0.1.7 及以上。宿主半边只用 node 内置模块，浏览器半边只向
  web shell 的静态模块表要 React；**没有任何第三方依赖**，也没有构建步骤。
- **分享性质，非长期维护项目**：按 MIT 原样提供，不承诺持续维护、也不承诺跟进上游 dsh 的接口
  漂移。发版清单见 [RELEASING.md](./RELEASING.md)（**tag 和 GitHub Release 是两件事**）。

---
## 安装

三种方式，**选一种，别混用**。装完都要**重启 dsh**（profile 只在启动时读一次）。

### 方式 A：一条命令（bundle 包，推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:BreakFree003/dsh-clinepass-deepseekv4.1
# 钉某个 tag：同上，末尾加 #v0.12.0
```

包自己声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，所以 `dsh plugin`（pnpm 的转发器）装上它之后会把这个包追加到
profile 清单的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里 —— 那两行配置（`- id: clinepass` 的 loader 行，以及声明
Cline Pass 卡片的 `- id: llm-pi-ai` 行）随包生效，**不需要手写任何东西**。卸载同样干净：
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-clinepass`。

### 方式 B：安装器（不需要 pnpm，离线可用）

```bash
node install.mjs                 # 默认装进 $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/plugins/dsh-clinepass
node install.mjs --dry-run       # 只打印会做什么
```

它把插件文件复制进 profile 的 `plugins/dsh-clinepass/`，给 `cordis.patch.yml`（会先备份）追加一行
loader 行（`name: './plugins/dsh-clinepass/index.js'`），并追加 `llm-pi-ai` 的 provider 行；如果你
自己的补丁里已经声明了 `llm-pi-ai`，它**不动你那一行**，只提示你把 `cline-pass:` 段自己写进去
（下面的 YAML 可以直接粘贴）。其它开关：`--dsh-home <path>` / `--profile <name>` /
`--name <dir>` / `--no-patch`。

### 方式 C：手动

把 `index.js` / `client.js` / `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` 复制进
`<profile>/plugins/dsh-clinepass/`，再照 [patch.example.yml](./patch.example.yml) 自己写 loader 行。

### 卡片从哪来

「Cline Pass」卡片就是一个普通的 pi-ai provider（`llm-pi-ai.providers.cline-pass`），有两个来源：

- **随包/随安装器声明的静态行**（方式 A / B 都写了这一行）—— 重启即有卡片，不看服务时序；
- **插件运行时的 `provisionProfile()`** —— 它认得出自己写的那张卡，只把模型条目的
  `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` 对齐成配置值，**绝不覆盖别人的卡**，也不改档位声明。
  在 dsh 0.1.7 上这次写入并不可靠（冷启动时 settings 服务还没起来；全新 profile 的写入会等
  清单写锁），所以**别只依赖它**。

> **自己写 `llm-pi-ai` 行的人必读**：静态卡声明了 `reasoningEfforts: {high, max}`，而运行时的
> `provisionProfile()` **只**对齐 `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` —— 它既不声明档位、也不改写你
> 写下的档位。而 patch 行是**整行替换 config、不合并**，所以自己写就必须把 `reasoningEfforts`
> 一起写上，否则这个模型在 composer 里没有任何思考档可选。可粘贴：

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  config:
    providers:
      cline-pass:
        displayName: Cline Pass
        api: openai-completions
        apiKeyEnv: CLINE_PASS_API_KEY
        baseURL: https://api.cline.bot/api/v1
        models:
          - id: cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash
            name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
            contextWindow: 921600
            maxTokens: 131072
            input: [text, image]
            reasoningEfforts:
              high: high
              max: max
```

## 设置 API key

**设置 → 模型 → Cline Pass** 卡片里的 **API key** 字段，填好保存。它写进 dsh 的凭据库，键名就是
`CLINE_PASS_API_KEY`（可用 `apiKeyEnv` 改）。

浏览器侧**读不到**这把 key —— dsh 的凭据缝是单向的（只能写）。所以用量卡不在浏览器里请求网关：
宿主半边用 key 去读，只把**数字**发回同一条同源路径。

## Provider 胶囊

在 composer 底部，显示这条路由**最近一次真实上游**：

- 有结论时是 `Provider: <名字>`（例如 `Provider: deepseek`）；悬停有说明，点一下立即重读；
- 网关返回**匿名标签** `openai-compatible-private`（VMC 回退网形状）时换成警示色 + 专门图标 +
  tooltip（contributor 档：数据可能用于训练，无 ZDR）；
- 还没观察到任何结论时显示 `Provider: --`（tooltip「等待 API 返回…」）；
- 数据来自状态文件，经宿主路由 `?status=1` 暴露；按 session → model 两级记忆；
- **读不到元数据就不给结论**：那种响应只计 `seen`，胶囊保持上一次的结论（或 `--`）。

服务端在放行终止帧之前就写完结论，所以一轮结束通常立刻可见；胶囊在回合结束后还会补读一次，
运行中每 2 秒刷新一次。

## 用量卡

**设置 → 模型 → Cline Pass** 卡片，三个**滚动窗口**：5 小时 / 每周 / 每月。

- 网关只报**已用**百分比（`percentUsed`），卡片显示的是**剩余** = `100 − percentUsed`，
  外加重置倒计时、读取时间，和一个刷新按钮（绕过缓存）。
- 数字来自 `GET https://api.cline.bot/api/v1/users/me/plan/usage-limits`（用你存的那把 key）。
- 上限本身不在这张卡上：它来自订阅的 `entitlements.cline_pass.inferenceCapThreshold`（三个窗口各自
  的美元阈值）。2026-10-16 标定过一次记账单位（1 单位 = 1e-8 USD，于是 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月 ≈
  **$10 / $25 / $50**；Cline 官方并不公布这些数字）—— 仅供理解量级，别当成契约。

## 配置项

`withDefaults()` 里的全部键；不写就是下面的默认值。

| 键 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `upstream` | `https://api.cline.bot` | 网关 **origin**（profile 的 baseURL 是它 + `/api/v1`）。带路径会被截成 origin 并警告；不是 URL 则什么都不装 |
| `provider` | `cline-pass` | 路由 id（卡片与胶囊都认它） |
| `model` | `cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 模型 id（请求体要带 `type/` 前缀） |
| `displayName` | `Cline Pass` | 设置页卡片标题 |
| `contextWindow` | `921600` | 登记/对齐卡片用 |
| `maxTokens` | `131072` | 同上 |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `CLINE_PASS_API_KEY` | 凭据库里的键名 |
| `provision` | `true` | `false` = 不登记/不修复 provider 卡片（那卡片就得自己声明） |
| `usage` | `true` | `false` = 不挂载用量路由（卡片会显示「没挂载」而不是一直转圈） |
| `usageRoute` | `/api/clinepass.usage` | 用量路由路径 |
| `usageTimeoutMs` | `15000` | 宿主读网关的超时 |
| `usageCacheMs` | `60000` | 成功读取的缓存时长；`0` = 每次重取（失败只缓存 5 秒） |
| `statusFile` | `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-clinepass-status.json` | 观察结果落盘处；给字符串换路径，`false` 关掉 |

## 迁移（0.11.x → 0.12.0）

**0.12.0 是删减版**，请求侧整块没了：

- 删掉的配置键：`pin` / `pins` / `providerPins` / `enforcement` / `retries`，以及
  `alignReasoningEffort` / `plainModelId`。**旧行照常加载** —— 这些键被忽略并记进状态文件的
  `ignoredOptions`（不刷警告，否则每个没清理的旧行都会在每次启动时叫一次）。更早的端口时代键
  （`transport` / `listen` / `captureDir` / `address` / `baseURL`）同样忽略，但会各警告一次。
- **为什么不再需要钉选**：2026-10-16 复测，订阅路由上的 `deepseek` 已由第一方服务（响应里的上游
  `system_fingerprint` 与官方 `api.deepseek.com` 逐字相同、prefix cache 是 64 块对齐记账、
  provider id 是 UUID 形状）。本地钉选改变不了任何结果，只剩每次请求多一段装饰字段。证据见
  [`../clinepass-deepseek-audit/README.md`](../clinepass-deepseek-audit/README.md) §九。
- **提示词变化**：0.6.2 起插件会把 persona 里的模型 id 去掉前缀；0.12.0 删掉了这件事，persona
  现在原样显示 `cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash`。
- **effort**：插件不再写 `agent-default-model.reasoningEffort`，也不再往卡片上写
  `reasoningEfforts`。想固定思考档就在自己的 profile 补丁里显式给（例：`agent-default-model`
  写 `reasoningEffort: high`），并在卡片里声明档位。

## 验证

```bash
npm test          # test-package → test-fetch → test-settings → test-usage → test-install，都不需要外网
node checks/dsh-clinepass-buffering-repro.mjs
node checks/dsh-clinepass-streaming-gate-check.mjs
node smoke-test.mjs [--negative]     # 活体：检查状态文件 + 真实网关往返
```

- 两个 `checks/` 脚本与 `smoke-test.mjs` 用的都是**安装副本**
  （`<profile>/node_modules/dsh-clinepass/index.js`；手工安装路线是 `plugins/dsh-clinepass/`）——
  所以**部署之后**才能跑，在源码仓里直接跑会红。
- `checks/dsh-clinepass-buffering-repro.mjs` 钉「逐帧转发」：观察者一旦退化成整包缓冲，分片节奏
  就变了（dsh 的 TPS 测量正是从它来的）。
- `checks/dsh-clinepass-streaming-gate-check.mjs` 用**真实 OpenAI SDK** 走一遍安装后的观察者：
  请求原样到达、流仍能装配出完整消息、同一个响应里的上游仍被读出来。
- `smoke-test.mjs --negative` 会故意要一个不存在的渠道，用来复述「请求侧钉选为什么在 0.12.0 被删」：
  网关无视那个字段。

### 状态文件

```bash
cat ~/.dsh/dsh-clinepass-status.json
```

| 字段 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `hook` | `installed` / `absent` / `replaced-by-us` —— 观察者是否真的挂在 `globalThis.fetch` 上 |
| `counters.seen` | 观察到的聊天请求数 |
| `counters.verified` | 读出了真实 provider 的数量 |
| `counters.anonymized` | 结论是匿名标签 `openai-compatible-private` 的数量 |
| `counters.unknown` | 响应里根本没有 provider 元数据的数量 |
| `lastVerified` / `lastAnonymized` | 最近一条结论：`{at, url, provider, model, sessionId, anonymized}` |
| `provision` / `provisionReason` | provider 卡片的登记结果与原因（`created` / `present` / `repaired` / `mismatch` / `off` / `pending` / `failed` / `unavailable`） |
| `ignoredOptions` | 被忽略的遗留配置键 |
| `pid` / `at` | 进程号 / 落盘时间 |

读法：`seen` 在涨而 `verified` 不涨 = 响应里没有 provider 元数据（网关形状变了）；
`hook` 不是 `installed` = 有别的插件先占了 `globalThis.fetch`。

## 卸载

- **方式 A（bundle）**：从安装目录跑 `node <profile>/node_modules/dsh-clinepass/uninstall.mjs`
  （连同它写的 provider 卡片一起撤），再 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-clinepass`。
- **方式 B（安装器）**：`node uninstall.mjs`（`--keep-provider` 保留卡片）。

两种都要**重启 dsh**，卡片才会从设置页消失。

## 安全与边界

- **不开任何端口**。用量功能是 dsh **已经在跑**的 HTTP 服务上的一条*路径*
  （`/api/clinepass.usage`），走 dsh 自己的 Host/Origin 信任栅栏与浏览器 cookie 认证。
- 观察者只匹配配置的 `upstream` origin 下的聊天请求；其它请求原样透传。
- 状态文件里只有结论与计数，**没有密钥**；插件也不记录请求头。
- 一个内部依赖：pi-ai 每次请求新建 client 且不传 `options.fetch`，所以真实传输就是全局 `fetch`。
  这条要是变了，观察会**静默失效** —— 状态文件的 `hook` 字段就是为暴露这件事存在的（用 `console`
  打印的其它插件会进宿主日志，而插件的 `ctx.logger` 行不一定落盘）。

## English

**dsh-clinepass** brings Cline Pass into DeepSeek Harness: it registers an OpenAI-compatible pi-ai
route (`cline-pass`) and does exactly two things — it **observes** the real upstream provider in the
gateway's chat responses (shown in a composer pill, persisted to a status file), and it **draws the
Cline Pass usage card** on Settings → Models.

**It never rewrites a request.** No body, no headers, no retries, no extra calls; SSE bodies are
forwarded frame by frame, never buffered. 0.12.0 removed the request-side channel pin, enforcement,
retries and violation bookkeeping, because the subscription route's `deepseek` is served first-party
(same upstream `system_fingerprint` as `api.deepseek.com`, 64-token-aligned prefix-cache accounting).
Legacy keys (`pin`, `pins`, `providerPins`, `enforcement`, `retries`, `alignReasoningEffort`,
`plainModelId`) still load — they are ignored and listed in the status file's `ignoredOptions`.

**Install** with `dsh plugin --profile web add github:BreakFree003/dsh-clinepass-deepseekv4.1` (the
package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so its two config rows come along automatically), with
`node install.mjs` where pnpm is not available, or by hand (`patch.example.yml`). Restart dsh, then
paste your key into the card on Settings → Models (stored as `CLINE_PASS_API_KEY` in the credential
store; the browser cannot read it by design, which is why the host half fetches the usage numbers).

**Configuration**: `upstream`, `provider`, `model`, `displayName`, `contextWindow`, `maxTokens`,
`apiKeyEnv`, `provision`, `usage`, `usageRoute`, `usageTimeoutMs`, `usageCacheMs`, `statusFile`. If
you declare the `llm-pi-ai` row yourself, include `reasoningEfforts` — the runtime provisioner only
aligns `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` and never touches the levels.

**Verify**: `npm test`, the two `checks/` scripts (they import the *installed* copy, so deploy
first), `smoke-test.mjs`, and `cat ~/.dsh/dsh-clinepass-status.json` (`hook`, `counters.seen` /
`verified` / `anonymized` / `unknown`, `lastVerified`, `provision`, `ignoredOptions`).

**Status**: shared as-is, not a maintained project — no support promise, and no commitment to track
upstream dsh changes. MIT.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

# dsh-ia

> 金融投资专家 Agent 插件（dsh）：投资建议、持仓记账、行情/交易日历与市场感知。

`dsh-ia` 是一个基于 [DeepSeek Harness（dsh）](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) 的 Cordis 插件。它以 system-prompt 注入一个「精通计算机技术的 A 股投资专家」人设，配套一套面向模型的金融工具、可进化的方法论 SKILL，以及一个独立进程的定时任务（感知）层，让 Agent 能自主完成「监听 → 研判 → 制定策略 → 记账 → 复盘 → 迭代」的全链路。

- 标的范围：ETF + A 股，多标的统一管理
- 分析方法：技术面起步
- Agent **不执行真实交易**；真实下单由用户离线完成，插件内的台账是 Agent 自己的模拟账户

## 核心特性

- **投资专家人设**：以 `advisor.md` 注入 system-prompt，定义角色、原则、工作流、自我进化与合规边界。
- **14 个金融工具**：台账（4）+ 策略（2）+ 预判（3）+ 复盘（5），经 `defineTool` 注册。
- **7 个定时任务工具**：`task_create` / `task_list` / `task_get` / `task_update` / `task_delete` / `task_enable` / `task_disable`。
- **7 个 SKILL**：5 个「可进化 SKILL」（方法论，随复盘迭代）+ 2 个「固有 SKILL」（固件约束，不进化）。
- **定时任务（感知）层**：独立的 loader → runner（独立 Node 进程）→ waker（定点唤醒投递）编排，支持 agent 动态注册任意 cron。
- **skill 可进化资产**：可进化 SKILL 落运行时数据目录的独立 git 仓库，`chokidar` watch 热更新，改 `SKILL.md` 无需重启。
- **固定会话 + 开场 notice**：冷启动自动确保定点会话并投递引导性开场消息。
- **统一日志 + 文件落地**：分级日志门面 + JSONL 文件 exporter + 字段级去敏 + trace 上下文。

## 架构总览

插件入口 `src/index.ts`，插件契约在 `src/plugin.ts`（导出 `name` / `inject` / `apply`）。能力按 dsh 原生维度组织为四类 + 一层公共包：

| 类别 | 目录 | 载体 | dsh 契约 |
|------|------|------|----------|
| 提示注入（投资专家人设） | `src/prompts/` | Markdown | system-prompt 注入 |
| 可复用指令（Skill） | `src/skills/`（种子）/ `<dataRoot>/skills`（运行时） | `<name>/SKILL.md` | `ctx.skills` |
| 模型工具 | `src/tools/` | `defineTool` | `ctx.tools` |
| 定时任务层（感知） | `src/scheduler/` | 独立定时任务层 | 见下 |
| 公共包 | `src/domain/` + `src/log/` | 纯 TS 模块 | 内部依赖 |

依赖注入契约固定为 `['tools', 'skills', 'fs']`（与 `cordis.patch.yml` 保持一致）；`systemPrompt` / `agents` 等经 `ctx.inject([...])` 动态声明，不加入顶层 `inject`。

**两个贯穿原则：**

1. **标的无关**：所有工具、脚本、数据模型以 `symbol` 为维度；prompt / skill 只在「策略方法论」层使用占位符号，具体数值一律**遵循该标的策略文档**，不写死任何单一标的。
2. **标的类型驱动**：`symbols.type`（`etf` / `stock`）决定行情数据源路由与交易单位；分析方法当前统一为技术面。

## 安装

前置：Node.js >= 22.19.0、pnpm >= 11.7.0，以及 dsh 宿主。

```sh
# 安装到某个 dsh profile（当前目录即本包）
dsh plugin --profile <name> add .
```

安装后由 profile 的 bundle patch（`cordis.patch.yml`，单插件包 `name` 写裸包名 `dsh-ia`）自动加载。

## 使用

在 dsh 会话中，Agent 会自动：

1. 以「金融投资专家」人设开场（固定会话冷启动时投递开场 notice，引导建立标的台账）。
2. 对每个关注标的：`ledger_init` 建账 → `strategy_set` 生成首版策略 → `task_create` 部署任务程序盯盘。
3. 收到任务程序唤醒回报后研判、按策略决策、在台账里 `ledger_trade` 执行并记账。
4. 盘后 `review_*` 复盘，双线迭代（更新策略文档 / 更新任务程序）。

> ⚠️ 交易时段纪律（A 股硬约束）：可下单时段为连续竞价 **9:30–11:30、13:00–15:00**。盘前（含集合竞价）、午休、收盘后禁止下单，工具层 `ledger_trade` 会兜底校验时段。

## 配置

全部经环境变量覆盖（dsh 启动器为严格模式，不接受自定义启动 flag）：

| 环境变量 | 作用 | 默认值 |
|----------|------|--------|
| `DSH_IA_HOME` | 工作区根目录（data / tasks / skills / workspace 归属全部跟随） | `~/.dsh-ia` |

## 数据目录

```
~/.dsh-ia/
├── data/                              # dataRoot
│   ├── ledger/<symbol>/…              # 台账（持仓 / 成本 / 流水）
│   ├── strategy/<symbol>.md           # 策略文档（文本实体，当前版）
│   ├── strategy_versions/<symbol>/…   # 策略版本链（+ rationale）
│   ├── skills/                        # 可进化 SKILL（独立 git 仓库，main=当前版本）
│   └── tasks/                         # 定时任务清单
└── logs/                              # 运行日志（JSONL）
```

`data/` 及子目录为**运行时动态创建**（非项目固有目录）；其中 `data/skills/` 是一个独立 git 仓库，由插件冷启动幂等预置。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm build        # 类型检查 + 编译 + 搬运 .md 资源到 dist-server
pnpm typecheck    # 仅类型检查
pnpm test         # 运行 vitest（--maxWorkers=4，避免 fs/git/chokidar 装配用例相互饿死）
pnpm clean        # 清理 dist / dist-server
```

## 目录结构

```
src/
├── index.ts            # 包入口
├── plugin.ts           # Cordis 插件契约（name / inject / apply）
├── paths.ts            # 路径解析（~/.dsh-ia、dataRoot、日志目录）
├── flags.ts            # 环境变量解析（home / session id 覆盖与派生）
├── session.ts          # 会话类型与工具
├── session-ensure.ts   # 固定会话确保（检查 → 恢复 → 新建）
├── opening-notice.ts   # 开场 notice 投递
├── message-source.ts   # 消息构造（producer 自有 source kind）
├── tools/              # 14 个金融工具
├── scheduler/          # 定时任务层（load → run → wake + 7 工具）
├── skills/             # SKILL 种子 + provider + 固件 skill 注册 + git 仓库
├── prompts/            # advisor.md 人设 + systemPrompt 注入
├── domain/             # 纯 TS 领域逻辑（台账 / 策略 / 预判 / 复盘 / 交易日历）
└── log/                # 日志门面 + 文件 exporter + 去敏 + trace
tests/                  # vitest 用例与独立验收报告
scripts/copy-assets.mjs # 构建期 .md 资源搬运
```

## 依赖

- **运行时 peer**：`@deepseek-ai/cordis`（>=4.0.0）、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`（均 `0.2.0-rc.2`，后三者为可选 peer）。
- **开发**：TypeScript ^5.7、Vitest ^3.0。

## 合规声明

本插件的全部输出仅用于辅助决策，**不构成投资建议或收益承诺**。插件只做分析、建议、推演与自身台账内的**模拟执行**，不触碰真实交易、不代客理财、不承诺保本、不诱导加杠杆。市场有风险，决策需谨慎。

# dsh-model-rotator

> [简体中文](./README.zh.md) | **English**

Model auto-ranking and transparent failover for DeepSeek Harness.

When the current model hits a quota wall, an expired credential, a rate limit or
a transient network error, this plugin switches to the next-best configured
model **inside the same turn** — and the user sees an ordinary reply.

## What it does

1. **Discovers** every dialable `provider/model` on this machine
   (`ctx.llm.listProviders()` + each adapter's `listModels()`).
2. **Filters** out families that cannot answer a chat turn — embeddings,
   rerankers, ASR/TTS, OCR, image/video generation, content moderators and
   judges. Dialing one of those can only fail the turn and burn a cooldown slot
   that a real model could have used.
3. **Skips the image-reading mode.** dsh-vision-router wraps a chat route into a
   twin (`<provider>-vision`) whose only job is to add image reading to that same
   model. It is one model reachable twice, not a second one, so failing a text
   turn over into it would answer through the image pipeline — and the
   same-model preference below would rank the twin *first*. Those routes are
   therefore never candidates (a model id that merely *mentions* vision is still
   a chat model and stays). The model list can switch one back on when a wrapper
   name does not follow the convention.
4. **Ranks** the survivors by measured connectivity (Laplace-smoothed success
   rate), speed (median TTFT and throughput) and an active failure cooldown. A
   model that *is* the current one — or a close relative of it — on another
   provider carries a bonus, because the model you picked is usually the model
   you want, just from a working channel.
4. **Retries before it believes a failure.** A provider fails transiently: a
   rate-limit blip, a reset socket, an overloaded channel. One miss therefore
   does not count as a fault — the same model gets `retriesPerModel` more tries
   (2 by default, 0–5), `retryBackoffMs` apart (300 ms, then the double of it),
   before the failure is acted on. A retry is not a switch: it asks nothing and
   changes nothing.
5. **Fails over** at the `llm/stream` waterfall: attempt 1 is the untouched
   harness path; a failure that produced **no content at all** abandons that
   attempt, closes its upstream stream, and re-dispatches the next candidate as
   a fresh `ctx.llm.stream()` — the same model first while retries remain, then
   the ranking above.

Once any content chunk has been yielded the attempt is never retried — a second
attempt would duplicate visible text. That zero-content window is exactly the
retryable window.

A turn the caller cancelled (Stop, a deadline, a closed client) ends there: the
walk stops instead of burning attempts on a reply nobody will read.

### What counts as content

"Flow" is the switch that closes the retry window, so it means *the user has been
shown reply text* — and nothing weaker. A `reasoning-delta` is not content: the
harness folds reasoning away again when a retry happens, which is exactly what
makes retrying a reasoning-loop or reasoning-effort failure safe. Markup chunks
(`block-start`, or a `block-end` carrying a reasoning block) are not content
either. Counting those was a real defect: a live model looked dead because a
block-start closed the window and the very next error was taken as final.

### Automatic calls are not conversation turns

A compaction summary and a session title ride the same `llm/stream` seam but are
not a user turn. Their refusals are usually statements about *that lane* — a
proxy answering "bili owns compression here" — so asking a second provider to
carry the plumbing is the wrong reflex: it burns a real model on work nobody
reads, and it is the single loudest source of spurious switching. The plugin
therefore passes any call carrying `purpose: "compaction"` or
`purpose: "session-title"` straight through, error included. An unnamed call —
every ordinary turn — keeps failing over exactly as before.

## Announcing a switch

A switch is otherwise silent: the reply simply arrives from a different model. By
default the plugin posts one line in the conversation when that happens —
`模型已切换：A → B`, with the failure kind in brackets when it is known
(`(quota)`, `(rate-limit)`).

| Behaviour | |
|-----------|--|
| Shape | the host's own notice mechanism: a `user/message` whose source is `{ kind: 'model-rotator/switch', form: 'notice', summary }`. The conversation UI renders that form as a context row, not as something you typed |
| Timing | at the turn boundary, via `agent/turn-stopping` + `agent.steer`. The switch already happened and the answer is already streaming, so announcing it mid-turn would insert a row in the middle of the reply it describes |
| Scope | the root conversation only. A switch inside a subagent transcript is somebody else's log |
| Off | `noticeSwitch: false` (or the settings-page toggle) |

The event type is deliberately **not** a private one. The persistence reader
refuses to interpret a session log containing a type it does not know
(`dsh-session`'s `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES`), so an invented event would make a
log carrying it fail to load. `user/message` is known, and `notice` is a form the
client already understands — the same pair the harness uses for its own
"model changed" line.

The vendor half of the label is the provider's own `displayName` when the host
publishes one (硅基流动 for `siliconflow`), falling back to the route id. The id
stays visible in the model list, because that is what `config.json`'s lists use.

## Asking before switching

A failover replaces the model the user picked, and it can do so silently. The
default is therefore to ask first: when the current model fails with no content,
the plugin raises a question in the conversation through the harness's own
human-interaction seam (`ctx.userQuestions.askTimed()`), offering **切换** and
**保持当前模型**.

| Reply | Outcome |
|-------|---------|
| 切换 (or any answer that is not a refusal) | the next candidate serves the turn |
| 保持当前模型 (or a typed refusal — 不/否/取消/拒绝/no/cancel/stop/…) | nothing further is dialed; the turn ends on the original error |
| no answer inside the window | the switch proceeds — the request was time-boxed, not vetoed |

The question is raised **once per turn**: approving the first switch covers the
rest of that walk, so a cascade of dead models does not become a cascade of
identical cards. The wait is 20 s by default and configurable.

Failover is deliberately fail-open. If the seam is missing, the ask throws, the
turn has no live root agent (a delegated sub-agent has nobody to answer), or the
timeout is reached, the walk continues unconfirmed. An unattended harness must
not stall on a card nobody is watching.

## The failure kind decides the rest

A failure is not just a string: it is classified, and the class decides how long
the model sits out.

**A quota wall is not a rate limit.** `429 insufficient balance` and `429 too many
requests` are the same HTTP status, yet one clears in seconds and the other does
not until the allowance resets. The plugin reads the kind out of the message -
`insufficient quota`, `out of credits, please top up`, `余额不足，请充值`, `额度已用尽`,
`402 Payment Required` and similar - and treats a balance problem differently:

| Kind | Rest | Retry first? |
|------|------|--------------|
| `quota` | until the next day at `quotaCooldownHour` (00:00 local by default), and never less than `quotaCooldownMs` | no - the balance does not refill between two dispatches |
| `auth` | ordinary exponential backoff | yes - a 403 from a burst-rate proxy does recover |
| `unsupported` | ordinary exponential backoff | no - the same provider returns the same refusal to the same request |
| `rate-limit` | ordinary exponential backoff | yes |
| `server` / `network` | ordinary exponential backoff | yes |
| unclassified | ordinary exponential backoff | yes |

`unsupported` is the request-shape refusal — *"provider X model Y does not
support reasoning effort high"*, *"unsupported model"*. It is decided before the
request is read, so the retry dispatches would repeat it verbatim; skipping them
is what turns a session-level mismatch into one switch instead of three.

An authentication failure is classified *before* a bare `429`, because waiting
never repairs a key: for `429 invalid api key` the honest name is `auth`, not
`rate-limit`. The distinction is recorded, not acted on - both take the same
backoff; only `quota` changes the policy.

The rest is at least "the following day at `quotaCooldownHour`". A wall hit at
23:50 still pays the full `quotaCooldownMs` floor, so it returns at 11:50 the
next day rather than ten minutes later at midnight.

`model_rotator_status` shows it: the ranking marks such a row `QUOTA-REST` (with
the remaining hours) rather than `COOLDOWN`, the `type` column names the class,
and a `last failure seen` line lists each model's last error with its kind.

Measured state - counters, the last error and kind, the cooldown horizon -
**outlives the process**, because the restart a user performs right after being
told their balance is gone must not undo the rest. It is written to
`%DSH_HOME%\model-rotator\stats.json` (or `dirname(config.json)`), debounced, and
read back once on first use. Latency samples deliberately stay in memory: they
are a 20-sample sliding window, and a stale window is worse than a short one.
`statsPersistTtlMs` bounds the age of a restored file (24 h by default; 0
disables the file entirely).

## What it does NOT do

It never reads, writes or rewrites model/provider configuration. It does not
touch `cordis.patch.yml`, `agent-default-model`, `llm-pi-ai` or any provider
registration. It only observes the stream waterfall at runtime.

## Non-chat filtering

The harness adapter strips the catalog's own `wire: 'chat'` marker before
handing rows to `listModels()`, so capability cannot be read off the row.
Name matching is the available signal, and it is deliberately narrow — a
pattern must not touch a chat model that merely mentions a modality
(`Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct` is chat; `Z-Image-Turbo` is not).

The filter denies families across vectors/ranking, speech, image generation,
document parsing and safety classifiers — in both the plain and the `-vision`
provider variants. It runs during discovery, so the count the plugin reports
(`discovered`) is already the post-filter pool, and a machine's numbers depend
entirely on which providers are configured. Ask a live install rather than
quoting a figure from here:

```
model_rotator_status      # "discovered" = candidates after this filter
```

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `model_rotator_status` | Read-only: enabled state, config path, discovered pool, measured ranking. |
| `model_rotator_benchmark` | Probe candidates with a minimal live request to refresh TTFT/throughput and cooldowns (bounded, spends a little quota). |
| `model_rotator_select` | Pin/unpin the head of the failover order; the ranking still decides the tail. |

The status tool also reports the two manual lists and the vision rule, so a model
the user can see in the directory but not in the ranking can be explained without
reading the code:

```
  disabled models  : workbuddy/hy3
  vision twins     : never a candidate (the dsh-vision-router mode wraps a model, it is not a second one)
  model list route : /_dsh/model-rotator/models (GET the grouped list; POST {key, enabled} to switch one off or on)
```

## Configuration

Optional, at `%DSH_HOME%\model-rotator\config.json` (hot-reloaded on change).
Every field has a safe default, so the plugin works with no file at all.

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "allowImageFailover": false,
  "maxCandidates": 4,
  "cooldownBaseMs": 60000,
  "maxCooldownMs": 1800000,
  "quotaCooldownMs": 43200000,
  "quotaCooldownHour": 0,
  "statsPersistTtlMs": 86400000,
  "confirmSwitch": true,
  "confirmTimeoutMs": 20000,
  "adoptSwitchedModel": true,
  "retriesPerModel": 2,
  "retryBackoffMs": 300,
  "preferSameModel": true,
  "weights": { "connectivity": 0.5, "speed": 0.3 },
  "excludeProviders": [],
  "excludeModels": [],
  "excludePatterns": [],
  "disabledModels": [],
  "enabledModels": [],
  "pinned": ""
}
```

- `enabled` — master switch.
- `allowImageFailover` — image turns are skipped by default: a text-only
  fallback cannot read an image, so failing over there would produce a wrong
  answer rather than a missing one.
- `maxCandidates` — cap per turn (hard ceiling 8).
- `cooldownBaseMs` / `maxCooldownMs` — exponential backoff bounds
  (`base * 2^(n-1)`, clamped to `max`).
- `quotaCooldownMs` — minimum rest after a quota wall (default 12 h, ceiling
  26 h). Counted from the failure, not rounded to the hour.
- `quotaCooldownHour` — local hour (0–23) at which an exhausted model may be
  tried again (default 0 = next midnight). The rest always reaches that hour of
  the *following* day, so a wall hit at 00:05 does not revive the same evening.
- `statsPersistTtlMs` — how long measured state survives a restart (default
  24 h, ceiling 30 d; 0 = do not persist).
- `confirmSwitch` — ask in the conversation before leaving a failed model
  (default `true`; see above).
- `confirmTimeoutMs` — how long that question waits before switching anyway
  (default 20000; clamped to 1 s … 10 min).
- `adoptSwitchedModel` — after a switch, make the model that actually
  answered the model of *this session*, so the conversation header shows what is
  really in use (default `true`). Session-local only: no provider configuration
  and no saved default is touched, and the harness's own "model changed" notice
  then names the right pair.
- `retriesPerModel` — extra tries the same model gets before its failure is
  believed (default 2, hard ceiling 5). A retry needs no confirmation because it
  does not change the model.
- `retryBackoffMs` — pause before each retry (default 300; the nth retry waits
  n times this, capped at 10 s).
- `preferSameModel` — rank the same model on another provider first, then close
  relatives, then the measured ranking (default `true`).
- `noticeSwitch` — post the one-line switch notice in the conversation (default
  `true`; see "Announcing a switch" above).
- `weights` — connectivity vs speed in the score.
- `excludeProviders` / `excludeModels` — keep specific routes out of the pool.
- `excludePatterns` — extra regex sources appended to the non-chat deny list.
  An invalid pattern is skipped, never fatal.
- `disabledModels` — models switched off from the model list on the settings
  page. Each entry is `"provider/model"` or a bare model id (which matches every
  channel serving that model). A per-row entry outranks the channel rule.
- `disabledProviders` — whole channels switched off from a channel header's
  button. One entry per provider id. Closing a channel also clears the per-row
  `enabledModels` entries inside it, so the switch cannot be silently undone;
  enabling a row afterwards writes a new entry that does take effect.
- `enabledModels` — the opposite, and the only way to put a vision twin back into
  rotation when its wrapper name does not follow the `<provider>-vision`
  convention. Written by the same switch.
- `pinned` — preferred head of the failover order.

## Settings page

The plugin ships both halves of a real settings page: the server-side `Config`
schema the Harness serves for the `model-rotator` namespace, and a browser
bundle (`client.js`, declared through `dsh.client` plus `exports["./client"]`)
that renders the form in two host cells from one component:

- **Settings → Model failover**, its own entry in the Settings navigation
  (`settings.section`, id `model-rotator`, order 20). The Harness renders the
  plugin settings pages this way; the shell hands the cell `{ close }` and
  filters by the registration id.
- the **model-rotator** card in the Plugins panel (`plugins.item`), which
  renders the same form as its card body.

Both cells only appear while the host actually serves the namespace. Only the
fields that are safe to personalize appear there:

| Field | |
|-------|--|
| `enabled` | master switch |
| `allowImageFailover` | also fail over image turns |
| `maxCandidates` | models one turn may try |
| `cooldownBaseMs` | backoff base |
| `maxCooldownMs` | backoff cap |
| `quotaCooldownMs` | minimum rest after a quota wall |
| `quotaCooldownHour` | hour at which an exhausted model returns |
| `statsPersistTtlMs` | how long measurements survive a restart |
| `confirmSwitch` | ask before switching |
| `confirmTimeoutMs` | how long that question waits |
| `adoptSwitchedModel` | show the switched model on this session |
| `retriesPerModel` | tries before a failure is believed |
| `retryBackoffMs` | pause between those tries |
| `preferSameModel` | same model on another channel first |

`weights.connectivity` / `weights.speed` are **not** on the page: the form
model stages one top-level key at a time, so nested values stay in
`config.json`. Long lists meant for editing by hand or by tool —
`excludeProviders`, `excludeModels`, `excludePatterns`, `pinned` — stay
there too.

### The model list

Below the settings form the same page renders **模型列表 / Models**: every
discovered `provider/model`, with its health and a switch — plus a switch on each
channel header that closes **every model behind that provider in one click**. The
pair of levels is deliberate: a channel switch is the useful action when a key or
an endpoint dies (everything behind it is unreachable at once), while a row switch
is what you reach for when one model is bad and its neighbours are fine.

The list is split into two sections, because they answer different questions:

| Section | Contents |
|---------|----------|
| **对话渠道** (chat channels) | the routes failover actually ranks — the candidates |
| **识图模式** (vision mode) | the `<provider>-vision` twins, each labelled with the channel it wraps (`amd-vision → amd`) |

**Three fold levels, all independent**: each section, each provider channel inside
it, and the roster as a whole. Chat channels start open and the vision section
starts **closed**: there are as many twins as everything else on this machine
(453 of 906 rows in the last live scan), and none of them is ever a candidate, so
leaving them folded is what makes the page readable at all. Two buttons —
**全部展开 / 全部收起** — open or close every section and channel at once.

Closing a channel writes a single `disabledProviders` entry rather than one entry
per model — the channel is the unit you are thinking in, and a list of a hundred
ids would be unreadable and impossible to undo honestly. Four rules keep the two
levels from fighting:

- the header button is labelled from the channel's own flag, not from whether its
  rows happen to be in rotation — a channel whose rows are all off for per-row
  reasons is still **open**, and one closed from the header must offer the action
  that reopens it;
- a closed channel offers **启用本渠道**, and the row switches underneath stay
  available for putting one model back without reopening the whole channel;
- closing a channel clears the stale per-row overrides inside it (so the button
  does what it says), and a row you switch on **afterwards** wins (a fresh,
  deliberate statement beats an older blanket one);
- a **vision** channel carries no channel switch at all. Its rows are kept out by
  the twin rule, which the channel flag cannot lift, so a button there would write
  an entry that changes nothing while reading like a promise. Use a row switch.

The channel label is the vendor name the host publishes on the registered route
(`硅基流动` for `siliconflow`), falling back to the route id when a route
publishes no label; the id is kept in parentheses when the two differ.

A folded line never hides what matters: every channel header (and every section
header) prints the same tally — derived from the rows, not from a host-supplied
counter, so the two layers cannot disagree. A collapsed provider still says
whether it is healthy. The page also rebuilds the sections from `channels` when
the host does not send `groups`, because the two halves are versioned together
but not *loaded* together.

```
▼ 对话渠道                    453 个 · 可用 447 · 冷却 6 · 关闭 0
    ▼ 硅基流动 (siliconflow)     65 个 · 可用 63 · 冷却 2 · 关闭 0   [关闭本渠道]
        ● deepseek-v4.1-flash   冷却中   retry in 511m · rate-limit      [关闭]
    ▶ cline                    55 个 · 可用 55 · 冷却 0 · 关闭 0   [关闭本渠道]
▶ 识图模式（vision-router 创建）  453 个 · 可用 0 · 冷却 0 · 关闭 453
```

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| dot + label | `可用` (nothing resting, no failure on record), `未测` (never tried), `冷却中`, `额度耗尽` (until the next-day boundary), `异常` (last attempt failed), `已关闭` |
| detail | TTFT and success/attempt counts, or the remaining rest, or why the row is out of rotation |
| switch | 关闭 / 启用 |

The reasons a row can be out of rotation are named rather than collapsed:
`manual` (switched off here), `vision` (the vision-router twin, a default the
switch can overrule), `provider` / `excluded` (from `config.json`),
`non-chat` (a family that cannot answer a chat turn), `combo` (a virtual
route). Only the first two are switchable from the page — the rest are
structural or owned by the file.

The roster reads its data over HTTP rather than through the settings form. Its
route is `/_dsh/model-rotator/models`: `GET` returns the grouped list
(`groups` = the two sections, `channels` = one entry per provider carrying its
`kind` and the `sourceChannel` a twin wraps, `models` = every row; a section and a
channel carry the same `models`/`ok`/`resting`/`off` counters, so one row shape
renders both and a folded line still reports its state),
`POST {key, enabled, scope}` flips one switch and answers with the refreshed list
(`scope: "provider"` for a channel header, omitted or `"model"` for a row). The
form carries the user's *policy* (how many candidates, how long to wait), while
this is a *roster* that changes whenever a provider republishes — and its rows
save one at a time, straight to `config.json`, so a refresh cannot discard a
half-typed number above it. The route is registered through
`ctx.inject(['webServer'], …)` because the host publishes the web server
*after* plugins load; it is auth-gated by the host exactly like every other
non-public path.

The two layers merge as **defaults < config.json < settings page**, and the page
wins only for the keys it actually owns: a key the page never sets still comes
from the file. `model_rotator_select` never writes a page-owned key back into
`config.json`, so a stale file value can never masquerade as authoritative.

The namespace is the plugin's cordis id (`model-rotator`) — a server half
without a client half shows nothing, which is why both ship together. A host
that ships no generic settings form has to be given one: the page is the
plugin's own React form, so the fields above are exactly the ones this bundle
stages, not every key the `Config` schema accepts.

The `Config` export needs schemastery *inside the host process*. The plugin
ships its own copy under `vendor/node_modules/` and loads that copy by absolute
path when a bare import cannot be resolved from the plugin's real path, which is
what makes the page appear on installs where the manifest link resolves outside
the profile's `node_modules`.

`model_rotator_status` ends with an **in force right now** block that lists the
merged value of every effective key next to the layer it came from
(`[default]`, `[config.json]` or `[settings page]`), so what is actually
driving the plugin is visible without reading two files and doing the merge in
your head. Further lines report the live picture: `ask channel` (whether the
pre-switch question can actually reach you, and why not when it cannot),
`adopt on switch`, `model in use now` (read from this session's request
header), `session switch` (whether the plugin can record the swapped model on
the session), `failure verdict` and `switch order`.

## Install

From npm (recommended):

```
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-model-rotator
```

From GitHub:

```
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chimneyQ/dsh-model-rotator
```

From a local checkout, the same command takes the directory instead:

```
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <path-to-this-directory>
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so its `cordis.patch.yml` wires the
plugin automatically, and it has no dependencies to build. A full app restart is
required for the host to load it.

To confirm the host actually wired it up (a failed first install can leave the
dependency recorded without adding the plugin to `dsh.profile.bundles`), check
that `dsh.profile.bundles` in `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/package.json` lists
`dsh-model-rotator`.

## Test

```
node test-offline.mjs     # failover + consent gate, against a stub harness
node test-settings.mjs    # server-side settings contract, against the host rules
node test-client.mjs      # browser bundle: loader shape, card registration, fields
```

All three run with no network and no DSH process. `test-offline.mjs` (135
assertions) covers failure-then-retry, no-retry-once-text-flows, image-turn skip,
all-candidates-failed, cooldown accounting, aborted-signal passthrough,
non-chat filtering through a real waterfall, tool registration, and the consent
gate (prompt off, approved, declined by button and by typed text, timeout,
one-question-per-walk, and every fail-open path). Failure classification and the
quota rest are asserted through the exported `classifyFailureKind()` and
`quotaRestUntil()` seams — day boundaries, the pre-midnight floor, a month
rollover, "a quota wall never burns a retry", "an unsupported request is not
retried", and the on-disk round trip including TTL expiry and a malformed file.
The non-chat assertions call the exported `isNonChatModelId()` seam so they
test the shipped pattern table rather than a copy of it.

Two later scenarios pin the defects fixed after the first live run: **16** — a
`-vision` provider is never dialed, while a *model named* something-vision
stays a candidate, and switching a twin back on really does restore it; and
**17** — a reasoning-only attempt still gets its retries, text still closes the
walk, and an empty `block-start` counts as nothing. The list route is driven
end to end in **14** through an opt-in HTTP harness (GET, POST, the file write,
a bare model id, an empty key, a hand-edited file, and the whole channel switch
including its precedence rules). **16** additionally
asserts the two page sections — the twins counted apart from the chat channels,
each naming the channel it wraps — and **15** that a `purpose: "compaction"` call
is passed through untouched while an ordinary turn still fails over.

Two more offline cases cover the record itself: a stored `lastErrorKind` is
re-derived from its prose when the file is loaded, so a pattern added in a later
build relabels the history it was written for (a stored quota wall keeps resting
until tomorrow instead of being retried the moment it is read back); and a failure
payload that arrives as an object is serialised rather than stringified into
`[object Object]` — unreadable, and unclassifiable, which would cost a real quota
wall its daily rest.

**18** covers the switch notice: the message shape the session accepts (a
`user/message` with form `notice`, a fresh id, a summary inside the host's
120-character bound), the vendor-name bug above, the turn-boundary delivery
through `agent.steer`, one notice per switch rather than per boundary, no notice
in a subagent transcript, none on an aborted turn, and the off switch.

Persistence makes the suite order-sensitive by nature: a cooldown that survives
the process would let scenario 5's dead keys decide scenario 9's candidate
order. Every harness therefore mounts onto a stats file of its own, and the two
that mean to assert across applies opt into sharing one explicitly.

`test-settings.mjs` (34 assertions) asserts the host's own rules, not this
plugin's opinion of them: it copies the shipped `volatileForm()` walk and
checks that the exported `Config` yields exactly the intended page fields
(a non-volatile sibling is dropped), and that the page outranks `config.json`
for the keys it owns while the file still fills the rest. It loads the host's
real `schemastery` and `cosmokit`, so `createVolatile()` handles behave
exactly as they do in the app.

`test-client.mjs` (44 assertions) runs `client.js` against a stub module
loader: the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load()` shape, the exported `apply` /
`inject`, the two cells (`settings.section` and `plugins.item`) registered for
the `model-rotator` namespace, and — the anti-drift check — that the fields the card renders and
stages are exactly the volatile fields the schema walk above yields. A field the
bundle forgets to stage is a setting nobody can edit; one it invents throws
`plugin card has no field <name>` inside the real form.

Its last block goes further than source matching: it renders the roster with a real
hooks runtime (state, effects, memoized callbacks, re-renders) against a payload
shaped like the host's, presses the buttons a reader would press, and asserts what
comes back — both sections, the derived tally, the folded and expanded states of
each fold level, and that the list is fetched exactly once. A regex can prove a
feature is mentioned; only a render proves it works, and this is what caught a
re-fetch loop the source checks could not see.

## License

MIT

# dsh-better-git-worktree

Git worktree **sessions** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a session can live in its own self-contained git working copy permanently, instead of the harness's review/acceptance lifecycle.

It borrows the UX of [`dsh-git-worktree`](https://github.com/wloops/dsh-git-worktree) (the composer switch, the session-list status indicator, the session-header menu) and drops everything else: there is no review checkpoint, no preview/apply, no delivery handoff. A working copy here is simply where the session works.

**Usage guide:** [`docs/USAGE.md`](docs/USAGE.md): surfaces, statuses, workflows, and a screenshot gallery.

![Session list statuses](docs/screenshots/02-session-list-statuses.png)

> The screenshots were taken on dsh 0.1.5 with the earlier, inlined version of this plugin. The session-row badge is now an icon in the row's leading cell instead of a text pill, so they are out of date until they are retaken on a 0.2.0 UI.

## What it does

- **Composer switch (blank sessions).** A `Worktree` toggle sits in the composer tool row. Turning it on opens one confirmation dialog; confirming creates the branch and working copy immediately and continues **that** session inside it. The toggle then reads ON and disabled.
- **`worktree_convert` tool.** Takes a session running in a checkout, creates a working copy, moves its uncommitted work into it (kept recoverable as a `git stash` entry), and continues the conversation in a session rooted there. The continuation carries the conversation **through the last completed turn**; see *Known limits* for what that means when the tool is called in a session's first turn. Once a session is in a working copy the tool is denied for that agent's scope, so it leaves the tool list.
- **Session-list status badge**, on the session row: **blue** Progressing, **green** Up To Date / In Sync, **amber** Behind, **grey** Unknown/Missing, plus a **yellow glow** when the branch needs rebasing. The row's hover card spells out the full status.
- **Header pill and menu, for every session.** The pill reads `<name> - <status>` (`brave-otter - Progressing`, `main - In Sync`). Its menu offers *Git Changes*, *Review branch vs `<default>`*, *git fetch*, *Copy worktree path* / *Open worktree folder* for working-copy sessions, and *Move this session into a worktree* for the rest.
- **Session "..." menu**: *Copy worktree path* and *Open worktree folder* on a session that has a working copy.
- **Archiving a worktree session asks about the working copy.** The official *Archive* actions (the row's hover button and the "..." menu row) are shadowed: a session with a working copy opens one dialog (*Remove*, *Keep*, *Cancel*) that names the path and branch and warns about uncommitted paths and unpushed commits. *Remove* also retires the dead workspace registration. Every other session archives exactly as before.
- **Background git with a cache.** TTL cache (single-flight, stale-while-revalidate), a 15 s background refresher, and a 90 s-throttled `git fetch` of the source checkout that never blocks a read (a copy's own refs update when the copy fetches; see Working copies).

The official Workspace UI stays in charge of the sidebar; this plugin only adds to it through the seats that UI declares (see [How it plugs in](#how-it-plugs-in)). It does not replace or disable any core row.

## Install

Installed from a git tag of this repository; it is not published to npm. Replace `<version>` with a released version (tags are named `dsh-better-git-worktree-v<version>`; see [the tag list](https://github.com/chrisjohnson/dsh-plugins/tags)):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/chrisjohnson/dsh-plugins.git#dsh-better-git-worktree-v<version>&path:/packages/better-git-worktree"
```

That installs the package into the profile and enables its bundle. If you manage the profile's `package.json` yourself, the pnpm equivalent is below, then also add `dsh-better-git-worktree` to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`:

```sh
pnpm add "git+https://github.com/chrisjohnson/dsh-plugins.git#dsh-better-git-worktree-v<version>&path:/packages/better-git-worktree"
```

> **Warning:** never install it by bare name. Unscoped `dsh-*` names on the npm registry can belong to unrelated authors.

Restart dsh. If you ran an earlier, in-tree version of this plugin, also **remove its old `ui-workspace` row** (the one whose `disabled` expression tests `betterGitWorktreeWorkspaceProvider`) and its old `better-git-worktree` row pointing at an `entry-rN.mjs`: the official Workspace UI must stay active, and this plugin no longer elects itself in its place. A fresh install needs no other row.

## Configuration

Nothing is required.

| Key | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stateDir` | `<dsh home>/plugins/dsh-better-git-worktree` | Directory holding the session-to-working-copy registry (`worktrees.json`). Unset, it is where earlier releases kept it, so an existing registry is found with no configuration. A relative value resolves against the dsh home (`$DSH_HOME`, else `~/.dsh`), never the working directory; `~` is expanded. A blank or non-string value falls back to the default with a warning. |

A misspelled key is warned about once at boot and ignored. A bundle patch layer replaces a row's whole `config`, so if you set `stateDir` on your row, restate any other key you rely on.

## Working copies

A worktree session gets its own **self-contained working copy**, nested inside the checkout it was branched from:

```
<repo>/.dsh-worktrees/<pet-name>/
```

It owns its git database (`git init` in place) and reads the checkout's objects through `.git/objects/info/alternates`, so nothing is downloaded, no object is duplicated, and no file is copied by a clone. The working tree is materialised from the session's starting commit, on a branch `dsh/<pet-name>`. A checkout that cannot be written to hosts its copies under `~/.dsh-worktrees/<pet-name>` instead.

That layout is what makes the sandbox sufficient. `dsh-sandbox` grants a session exactly one writable root, its own cwd, and a *linked* worktree keeps its index and refs in the source repository, one directory outside it, so `git add`, `commit`, `push` and anything that shells out to git would stop for an escalation. Here every write git makes (index, refs, new objects) lands inside the copy, so plain `workspace-write` is enough.

Two trade-offs, deliberately accepted:

- It is not a linked worktree: the checkout's `git worktree list` does not show it, and its branch lives in the copy until it is pushed (pushes go to the same `origin` the checkout uses).
- It borrows the checkout's object store, so deleting that checkout loses history the copy has not republished.
- A new copy has only its own branch: `origin`'s refs (and so the comparison with the default branch, the *In Sync* state and the rebase glow) arrive with the copy's first `git fetch`, from the header menu or the agent.

The checkout's own `git status` stays clean because creating a copy writes `.dsh-worktrees/` into `<repo>/.git/info/exclude`: local to the clone, no tracked file touched. If that entry is ever missing, the header menu offers to write it again.

## Status semantics

| Badge | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| blue `Progressing` | work is not published yet: no upstream, or commits ahead of it |
| amber `Behind` | the upstream moved on and the branch has nothing of its own |
| green `Up To Date` | exactly in step with its upstream, but not identical to `origin/<default>` |
| green `In Sync` | in step with its upstream **and** identical to `origin/<default>` |
| grey `Missing` | the recorded working-copy directory is gone |

A **yellow glow** is a separate overlay: the branch has its own commits and `origin/<default>` has moved on, so it needs rebasing. Working-tree detail (staged / modified / untracked) is in the hover text, not the colour.

## The registry

`$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-better-git-worktree/worktrees.json` is the only record of which session works in which copy. Its format (`"version": 1`) is the one every release of this plugin has written, and it is read unchanged. It is written atomically (temp file in the same directory, then rename), it is never written before it has been read, and records or fields this release does not understand are written back as they were. If the file exists but cannot be read, parsed, or has another version, the plugin says so at boot, **leaves the file alone**, runs with an empty in-memory registry, and refuses to create new copies (it could not record them).

## How it plugs in

Verified against `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` 0.2.0-rc.2 (`lib/types/client/contract/slots.d.ts`, `lib/client.js`):

| Seat | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `sidebar.session.row.leading` | the status badge (rendered only by an idle row; a busy or pending row shows its own state dot instead) |
| `sidebar.session.row.hover` | the status text on the row's hover card |
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | *Copy worktree path*, *Open worktree folder*; and a same-id `archive` entry at priority -1 that shadows the official one |
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` | the same shadow for the hover archive button |
| `shell.overlay` | the archive dialog |
| `conversation.input.left` | the composer switch |
| `conversation.session.header.actions` | the header pill and menu |

A shadow reuses the official component and locale and the official inject result unchanged except for the `archiveSession` callback, which is wrapped so the dialog can run first. If the shadow ever crashes the renderer retires it and the official entry shows again.

`dsh-better-sidebar` is an optional integration: with it the header menu's *Review branch* opens a right-sidebar tab (and *Git Changes* opens its git lens); without it the review opens in a modal and *Git Changes* does the same.

## Known limits

- The keyboard shortcut for *Archive session* calls the official archive directly and is not intercepted: it archives without the dialog and leaves the working copy on disk (the *Keep* outcome).
- The status badge is drawn only in a row's leading seat, which the official UI renders only for an idle row. There is none on a busy row, a row with a pending interaction, a completed-unread row (its dot), a row with running subagents, an archived row or a blank session, and none in search results. The hover card still shows the status text where the row's hover seat is mounted.
- A working-copy session is a workspace of its own in the sidebar (named after the copy) and is listed in the new-session workspace dropdown; the official UI offers no seat to regroup it under the project it was branched from. The sidebar's "Group by: Workspace Tree" view option nests a copy under a registered repository workspace by path, but that is a per-browser setting the plugin cannot set.
- *Remove* in the archive dialog archives the session first and deletes the copy only if that succeeded, so it does nothing while the session is running (the harness refuses to archive running work): stop the session, then archive it again. The dialog's warnings count uncommitted paths, unpublished commits (on HEAD, any branch or any tag, minus anything on a remote-tracking ref, in the source repository or at the commit the copy started from, so a fresh copy's local commits count before it has ever fetched) and stash entries. If any of that could not be read (git failed or timed out, or the source repository moved), the dialog says it could not verify the copy and **Remove is disabled**; Keep still works. Remove is also unavailable while another session still works in the copy (the source row of a conversion).
- The host re-checks before deleting: the `remove` endpoint forces a fresh read and refuses a copy that cannot be verified (including one that is not a repository of its own, whose `git` would otherwise resolve to the source checkout), and refuses one with uncommitted paths, unpushed commits or stash entries unless the request confirms exactly the plan the host just computed. Ignored files and folders (`.env`, `node_modules/`) are summarized in the dialog but never block it.
- Not counted: unpushed work inside a nested repository or submodule of the copy (it appears only as an untracked or modified path of the copy), and work in other worktrees of the copy.
- A copy created from a source on a detached HEAD, from a registry record written before `baseOid` was stored, may show that starting commit as one unpushed commit (a conservative false warning).
- A running session cannot change its checkout (`session.header.cwd` is immutable), so *convert* creates a session in the working copy and continues the conversation there. The new session is seeded with the source's events through its **last completed turn**. The turn that makes the call (the `worktree_convert` tool call, or the turn in progress when the header menu is used) has not ended yet, so it is not carried: when the source has no completed turn, which is the case when the agent calls the tool in a session's first turn, the new session starts **blank** (the tool reports "A new session (...) was created in the worktree; open it to continue there", with `conversationCarried: false`) and the source session is **not archived** (it is archived only when the conversation was carried). The harness's own session fork has the same rule (it answers `session/fork-unavailable: ... has no completed turn to fork from`). The in-tree plugin this was extracted from behaved identically.
- `Open worktree folder` needs a desktop opener on the host (`xdg-open`, `gio`, ... `open` on macOS, `explorer` on Windows); without one the menu says so.

## Session format

This plugin writes no messages of its own into sessions. A continuation session is seeded with the source session's events through its last completed turn (format V4 events, unchanged).

```sh
node scripts/verify.mjs --package dsh-better-git-worktree
```

The tests use real temporary git repositories for creation, change-move, status folding and review, and mount the real host on a mock context.

Requires dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or later (`engines.dsh` and the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` peer: `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || >=0.3.0-0`).
