### 验证与卸载 安装后重启 `dsh web` 服务，侧边栏出现对应功能图标即代表加载成功；亦可通过执行 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 检查配置层挂载状态。若侧边栏未刷新出入口，请确认服务进程已彻底重启。 卸载聚合包：`dsh plugin --profile web remove @linxin666/dsh-web-all`，完成后重启 `dsh web` 即可恢复纯净状态。 技术实现细节与挂载原理解析见 [docs/plugins.md](docs/plugins.md)。 ### 安装排障
展开查看常见安装与构建排障方案
> **pnpm 严格依赖隔离导致模块找不到**：pnpm 的 isolated 模式默认仅将聚合包放置在顶层，部分子包可能被嵌套收敛，导致 `dsh web` 启动时报错 `Cannot find package '@linxin666/dsh-...'`。若遇到此情况，可在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中添加配置 `nodeLinker: hoisted`（或 `public-hoist-pattern: ['@linxin666/*']`）后重新安装。 > **构建脚本被拦截 (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS)**：首次安装时若提示第三方包的构建脚本被拦截，可根据终端指引将 `cloudflared`、`cpu-features` 以及 `ssh2` 加入 profile 所在 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds` 列表中。 > **pnpm 11 发布时间门禁问题**：在包版本发布后的短时间内，pnpm 11 的默认安全策略（`minimumReleaseAge`）可能会尝试回退拉取旧版本。建议在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中排除相关命名空间以确保获取最新版本： > > ```yaml > minimumReleaseAgeExclude: > - '@linxin666/*' > ```
## 兼容性与运行环境 dsh-web 针对主流操作系统、现代化浏览器及网络拓扑进行了深度工程调优与兼容性保障： | 维度 | 支持范围与技术规格 | | --- | --- | | 宿主运行环境 | DeepSeek Harness CLI (`dsh web`)、官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop） | | 操作系统 | macOS (Apple Silicon M 系列 & Intel 芯片)、Windows 10/11 (含 WSL2)、Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch, CentOS 等) | | 浏览器与设备 | 桌面浏览器 (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox)；移动端现代浏览器 (iOS Safari, Android Chrome 等) | | 网络连接架构 | 本机环回访问 (127.0.0.1)、局域网多设备互联 (LAN)、公网隧道安全穿透 (Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale, FRP, Nginx 反向代理) | | 模型供应商覆盖 | DeepSeek 官方通道与满血模型、OpenAI (GPT-4o 等)、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、Kimi (Moonshot)、GLM (智谱)、MiniMax、Ollama 本地大模型、SiliconFlow 等 | | 运行时依赖 | npm 方式安装无特殊环境依赖；源码编译需 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm >= 9 | ## 常见问题
安装重启后，侧边栏未显示插件入口？ 请首先检查插件是否正确安装至 `web` profile（命令需包含 `--profile web`），并通过 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 验证配置层是否已成功挂载。注意仅刷新网页无法加载新模块，必须彻底重启 `dsh web` 后端服务进程。
定时任务为何未能按时触发执行？ 任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，无需保持前端浏览器页面打开。若宿主进程退出、系统关机或整机进入深度睡眠，错过的触发时间点将遵循跳过策略处理，不执行回填补跑；若任务到达触发点时上一轮仍在运行，会自动顺延至下一个周期。若需要允许息屏但防止主机自动睡眠，可开启任务看板自带的电源保护选项。
手机端配对后为何没有收到流式推送？ 流式推送走官方 WebSocket 通道，配对后经门控的 `/remote` 代理转发。隧道中断期间更新暂停，通道恢复后继续，无需重新配对；更新节奏的差异来自远程链路的广域网往返延迟。
试穿主题皮肤不满意如何还原？ 皮肤面板提供免落盘试穿功能：点击试穿即刻在当前界面生效预览，离开面板或关闭预览会自动恢复初始外观；只有显式点击“应用”按钮才会将主题配置写入磁盘，可放心预览各类主题。
是否可以仅使用主题皮肤或某个单一插件？ 完全支持。若仅需要视觉定制，直接安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center` 即可；若仅需特定功能，参考“单独安装某个插件”章节直接安装对应 npm 包即可。
已安装全家桶的前提下，能否额外独立安装某个子插件？ 可以。聚合包内部的插件注册标识均统一带有 `web-ui-` 前缀（例如 `web-ui-usage`），与独立包的原生标识（如 `usage`）相互独立，不会产生 loader entry 重复冲突。宿主服务对同类插件会自动去重。通常情况下安装全家桶即可满足完整需求，无需重复安装单个子包。
如何通过手机或平板远程访问 DeepSeek Harness？是否必须在同一 Wi-Fi 下？ 手机远程访问基于配对令牌安全门控。若手机与运行 DSH 的电脑处于同一局域网（Wi-Fi），电脑端点击侧边栏手机图标弹出二维码，手机直接扫码即可打开完整的移动端交互界面。若需要公网跨网络访问（例如在户外使用移动蜂窝网络访问家中电脑），可搭配 Cloudflare Tunnel（例如 cloudflared）或 Tailscale 将 DSH 端口穿透至公网，手机打开公网链接配对访问即可，通信全程走鉴权通道，未配对请求将被严格拦截。
关闭浏览器或电脑休眠后，DeepSeek 的定时任务还会继续运行吗？ 任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，关闭浏览器标签页不影响定时任务的触发与执行。但如果整机进入深度睡眠或关机，宿主进程将暂停运行，离线期间错过的触发点会遵循跳过策略处理。若希望保持无人值守后台自动化，可在任务看板设置中开启“电源保护”选项，该选项会阻止系统因空闲进入休眠（允许显示器正常熄灭），确保定时任务准时触发。
如何查看和监控 DeepSeek 及其他模型 API 的 Token 消耗与账户余额？ 安装使用统计插件后，在“设置 > 使用统计”面板中可查看按日汇总的输入、输出与缓存 Token 数量，支持按模型细分查看 30 天消费趋势。针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费估算；若配置了支持查询余额的供应商 API，插件可定时拉取当前账户剩余额度与重置周期。
多个 AI 智能体（Agent）并发编码时，如何避免 Git 分支和代码冲突？ 直接在单一 Git 工作区并发运行多个智能体容易导致代码互相覆盖。使用全家桶内置的 Git 图谱插件，可以在新建会话时自动或手动创建独立的 Git Worktree。每个智能体会话在各自专属的分支和物理目录中独立运行、提交修改，彻底隔绝主工作区文件，开发完成后可在图谱面板中清晰比对并合并分支。
## 已知限制 - 任务看板由后端 Host 进程统一调度，关闭前端标签页不影响任务执行；但若宿主进程停止或操作系统关机睡眠，处于离线期间的触发点将直接跳过不补跑。可选的电源保护仅阻止系统闲置睡眠，无法阻止用户主动合盖、手动休眠或电源切断，技术细节见 [dsh-task-board README](packages/dsh-task-board/README.zh.md)。 - SSH 凭据（密码与私钥口令）保存在本地 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 文件中（文件权限为 0600）；在网络中断重连时可能重新发送非幂等命令，终端输出保持原样返回不执行脱敏，安全规范见 [dsh-ssh README](packages/dsh-ssh/README.zh.md)。 - 移动端流式输出经隧道或固定域名中继转发，广域网往返延迟叠加在每次更新上；固定域名中继比裸快速隧道多一跳，两者都可用。 - 从源码构建全仓需要 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm 工具链，直接从 npm 安装不受此限制。 ## 社区 欢迎加入社区交流群，与开发者及其他用户探讨使用技巧、反馈使用问题或提出新功能建议。 扫描下方二维码加入“DSH Web 交流群”： 也可以通过 [Discord 社区](https://discord.gg/6v4gm9u4S) 进行交流，或前往 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/issues) 提交缺陷报告与功能需求。 ### 关键词索引（Keywords & Topics） `DeepSeek` · `DeepSeek Harness` · `DSH` · `DeepSeek Web` · `DeepSeek Web UI` · `DeepSeek 网页版` · `DeepSeek 桌面客户端` · `DeepSeek Desktop` · `DeepSeek-V3` · `DeepSeek-R1` · `DeepSeek 插件` · `DeepSeek 扩展` · `DeepSeek 任务看板` · `DeepSeek 定时任务` · `DeepSeek Cron 自动化` · `DeepSeek 手机版` · `DeepSeek 远程控制` · `

# @linxin666/dsh-win-bash English | [中文](README.zh.md) A pinned, private bash for Windows x64 DSH sessions. The plugin ships its own Git for Windows MinGit payload, keeps one persistent bash process per session behind the `win_bash` tool, and never falls back to a bash found on `PATH`. ## Why Models write shell commands in bash syntax - pipelines, `$VAR`, single quotes, here-documents - and a Windows session whose only shell is PowerShell answers many of them with a syntax error. Each error costs a round trip and teaches the model nothing about the right dialect. This package removes that loop by giving the session a real MSYS2 bash whose version and bytes are pinned, so the dialect the model writes is the dialect that runs. The shell is persistent because shell work is stateful: a command that `cd`s or exports a variable expects the next command to see it. One process per session is what makes that true. ## What it does - Registers ONE model-facing tool, `win_bash`. The name is deliberately not `bash`: the host already mounts its own bash-family tools, and sharing a name would replace or be replaced, silently either way. - Keeps one persistent `bash -s` process per calling session. The working directory, exported variables, functions, aliases and shell history survive across calls for that session and belong to no other session. - Runs each call as a foreground command with bounded stdout and stderr, separated streams, and the command's real exit code. Output past the budget is reported as truncated, in the text the model reads, rather than being cut silently. - Optionally runs a command as a background job in its own pinned bash process and returns a job id at once, so a long build or watch does not hold the call open or die with the session's shell. See [Background commands](#background-commands). - Verifies the vendored payload against its SHA256 manifest before the tool is registered at all; a mismatch refuses the mount. - Replaces the host's own `pwsh` tool on the session's model-facing surface while `win_bash` is registered, so command work goes to bash instead of to the shell a model already knows. See [Which shell to use](#which-shell-to-use). It adds no settings section, no HTTP route and no browser half: the Host renders this row's configuration form from the plugin's own Config schema. ## Which shell to use The preference this plugin installs is a ladder, and it is a Windows ladder: 1. **`win_bash`** for command work. It is the pinned MSYS2 bash, its state survives across calls, and the dialect a model writes for it is the dialect that runs. 2. **`pwsh`** for the Windows-native work only PowerShell does - cmdlets, the registry, Windows services - and as the fallback when a command is not bash. The Host resolves it, so a machine with PowerShell 7 installed gets `pwsh` and one without gets the Windows PowerShell the platform ships. This package carries no PowerShell payload of its own. While `win_bash` is registered, this plugin withdraws `pwsh` from the session's tool surface, which is what makes the first rung stick: a model that can see both shells picks the one it already knows, and nothing in a tool schema outvotes that habit. The effect is exactly that - a session with one listed shell - so the mnemonic the `win_bash` description carries is "hides it rather than forbidding it". - **Visibility only.** A `pwsh` call a model makes deliberately still runs. There is no execution guard and no pre-execute denial: withdrawing the fallback rung outright would trade a preference for a capability loss. - **Per session, never process-wide.** The withdrawal is a scoped tool restriction on the sessions this plugin serves. Anything else in the same deployment keeps the surface it composed. - **Only while `win_bash` is actually mounted.** A refused availability gate, a payload that fails verification, a non-Windows host, or a row with `replacePwsh: false` leaves `pwsh` exactly where it was. Withdrawing the only usable shell of a deployment that ends up with no replacement shell would leave the session with neither. - **Windows only.** On POSIX the host shell is bash, win_bash does not mount, and this logic produces no restriction, no listener and no effect at all. - **Reversible.** Every restriction is lifted when its session is disposed and when the plugin unloads, one isolated callback at a time. Set `replacePwsh: false` to list both shells side by side and advertise the preference with the tool description alone. ## Availability The tool serves sessions that run the LiangShen (梁神) agent preset, so its availability follows that preset's **declaration**. At mount the plugin asks the harness's agent-preset registry whether a preset with id `liangshen` is declared; when it is, the tool registers, and when it is not, no tool is registered at all and one info line states the reason. A tool that mounted and refused every call would teach the model a capability the session does not have, which is worse than an honest absence. Three verdicts are distinguishable in the log, because they need different actions: the preset is declared (registered), no such preset is declared (enable the `dsh-liangshen` plugin row), and no usable agent-preset registry is published in this deployment. Setting `syncWithLiangShen: false` skips the gate entirely and always registers the tool. The verdict waits for the host plugin tree to settle and then reads the roster. A read that already carries the declaration decides at once; one that does not is re-read on a short bounded schedule, because the declaring plugin publishes its preset off its own activation return and the two can therefore land in either order. A late declaration is never turned into a refusal. The registry declares no roster-change event, so the verdict is decided once per mount. Toggling the LiangShen row takes effect for `win_bash` after the plugin manager refreshes the profile — the same freshness model the rest of the family uses, not an immediate one. ## Install ### From the repository (development) ```sh git clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git cd dsh-web pnpm install pnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-win-bash build dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-win-bash ``` The bundle patch marks this package's row disabled on every non-Windows host, so a POSIX profile can carry the same composition without mounting anything. ## Configuration | Field | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `timeoutMs` | 300000 | Whole-call wall-clock limit in milliseconds (1000..3600000). On expiry the shell is stopped and the next call starts a fresh one. | | `maxStdoutBytes` | 131072 | Visible stdout byte budget (1024..1048576). Output past it is dropped from the front, and the result says so in its text. | | `maxStderrBytes` | 32768 | Visible stderr byte budget (1024..524288). | | `enableRunInBackground` | true | Whether `run_in_background` is offered. The parameter is advertised only when this is true and the deployment composes a job registry; a deployment without one never offers it, and a call that asks for it anyway is refused rather than run in the foreground. | | `description` | built-in | Model-facing tool description; deployments may describe their own environment. | | `syncWithLiangShen` | true | When true, the tool registers only while the `liangshen` agent preset is declared; false skips that gate and always registers. | | `replacePwsh` | true | While this tool is registered, withdraw the host's `pwsh` tool from each session's model-facing surface. Visibility only: a deliberate `pwsh` call still runs. False lists both shells. | ## Tool interface | Parameter | Required | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `command` | yes | The bash command to run, any number of lines. | | `workdir` | no | Working directory for this command. Omitted keeps the shell's current directory. | | `timeoutMs` | no | Per-call limit, clamped to the configured ceiling. | | `run_in_background` | no | Run in a separate pinned bash process and return a job id at once. Offered only while a job registry is composed (see [Configuration](#configuration)). | The result carries `stdout`, `stderr`, the command's `exitCode`, the truncation facts for both streams (`stdoutTruncated`, `stderrTruncated`, `stdoutLostHead`, `stderrLostHead`, `frameOverflow`, and the `stdoutSpillPath`/`stderrSpillPath` files holding a complete stream), and `jobId` when the call started a background job. When a stream was cut, the model-facing text ends with a line such as: ```text [win_bash: stdout was truncated, only the last 131072 bytes are shown; the beginning was dropped; a middle window was dropped by the frame watch limit] ``` ## Background commands `run_in_background: true` runs the command in its OWN pinned bash process — the same absolute payload path, the same environment contract, the same confinement — and returns the job id immediately instead of waiting for the command. Collect that job with the host's `job_output` and stop it with `job_kill`. The separate process is the point, not an implementation detail. The session's persistent shell lives inside the subprocess provider's managed process range, and disposing that range terminates every process still running in it, so a job started with a trailing `&` dies with the shell that started it — on the next timeout, the next abort, or the session's disposal. A background command therefore owns its own process and outlives the call that started it. - **Its own shell.** Never the session's persistent one, so a background command cannot disturb the current directory, the exported variables or the history of the foreground shell. - **Same environment contract.** `PATH` with the payload's `usr/bin` first, `MSYSTEM=MSYS`, `TERM=dumb`, `--norc --noprofile`, and `TMPDIR`/`TMP`/`TEMP` pointing at a private directory owned by that job. - **Same mode rule.** A restricted session is refused with the same `SANDBOX_UNSUPPORTED` error a foreground call raises, before any process is started and before any job is registered. - **No timeout.** The call returns as soon as the job is registered; the command's own lifetime is bounded by `job_kill` and by the session ending. - **No silent downgrade.** On a deployment that composes no job registry the call is refused with `BACKGROUND_UNAVAILABLE` and says so; it is never quietly run in the foreground, which would hang the caller for the command's whole lifetime and then die with that shell. ## Permissions The tool resolves the calling session's effective sandbox policy from the same sandbox-policy service the host's own enforcing families use, and it resolves it FOR THAT SESSION — a session's own mode outranks the deployment default, so a session the user restricted cannot reach this shell through the default. **This tool runs only under `danger-full-access`.** Any other mode is refused with `SANDBOX_UNSUPPORTED`, before a process is spawned: the pinned MSYS2 bash cannot start under a restricted token, so confinement cannot produce a working shell here. Measured on win32 x64 (Windows 10.0.26200) against the real restricted-token runner: `bash.exe`, `sh.exe`, `dash.exe` and `echo.exe` all die before `main` with ```text NtCreateDirectoryObject(\BaseNamedObjects\msys-2.0S5-): 0xC0000022 ``` (exit 3221225794 / 0xC0000142), and system Git for Windows fails identically (`couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5`). `cmd.exe`, `node.exe` and `powershell.exe` run confined on that same runner, so the runner is sound and the limitation belongs to the MSYS runtime. Refusing is the honest answer, not the cautious one: a shell whose every command dies before `main` would still be reported as running inside a boundary that never actually held a command. The refusal names the host's `bash`/`pwsh` tools, which ARE confined, so a restricted session keeps a route rather than losing one. This tool offers no per-call escalation argument. ## Payload The vendored runtime comes from Git for Windows `v2.56.0.windows.2` (the official upstream release), reduced to the shell, its userland and its exact DLL closure. Two assets of that release supply it: the MinGit archive `MinGit-2.56.0.2-64-bit.zip` carries everything except `usr/bin/sleep.exe` and `usr/bin/seq.exe`, which MinGit does not ship at all and which come from the same release's full `Git-2.56.0.2-64-bit.tar.bz2`. Every file is registered in `runtime/win32-x64/checksums.sha256` and every redistributed component's license text ships beside it. [PROVENANCE.md](PROVENANCE.md) records both source URLs and digests, the curation rules, the payload inventory and the license mapping. ## Known limitations - Windows x64 only. The payload is a Windows MSYS2 build and the tool refuses to substitute a bash from `PATH` on any other platform or architecture. - No ssh client is vendored. The MinGit tree's OpenSSH family is deliberately excluded; use the session's own tools for remote work. - One shell per session, and the session's shell dies with it. A shell that exits or wedges is replaced on the next call, and that call says so. - A command that prints past the visible budget loses the front of its output. The tail is what is kept, and the result says it was cut, how many bytes are shown, and where the complete stream is when the provider spilled one. - A background job is one command in one process: it has no persistent state across jobs, and it cannot be promoted from a running foreground call (a foreground call that hits `timeoutMs` still stops its shell). ## Follow-up work - A packaging-time verification script that re-downloads the pinned source assets, rebuilds the payload and diffs the result against `checksums.sha256`, so a payload refresh is machine-checked rather than hand-reviewed. ## License Apache-2.0 for this package's own source. 标记完成前，必须由看板调用裁判模型验收（默认继承宿主模型，也可在「设置 → Web 插件 → 任务看板 → 任务验收」中自选模型与思考档位）。验收沿用三项 coding 判据、0.65 阈值与每项两轮交换 A/B 位置，同一执行最多两次：第一次不通过会把分数与问题反馈给 agent 修复，第二次仍不通过即判该执行失败。验收配置在每次执行启动时固定，之后的设置变更只影响新执行；普通聊天与显式关闭 **即时生效与冲突保护**：配置复用官方存储通道，未编辑的字段保持原样，修改保存后即刻生效且无需重启服务；每次写入附带配置版本校验，避免多端并发修改引发覆盖； - **供应商一键停用与启用**：支持临时禁用某供应商路由并自动归档配置，模型选择器将即时下线该供应商，保存的 API 密钥与凭据全程不受影响，后续可随时一键恢复。 evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Claude Opus 5.5 · DeepSeek Harness Agent Preset

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

把 **Claude Opus 5.5 系统提示词**（`prompt/` 下七段，约 95 KB）作为人格层，接到
**DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** 的 agent 预设上。装好后在 dsh 里选「Claude Opus 5.5」
即可得到一个带完整编码工具链、但身份 / 语气 / 判断准则按 Claude Opus 5.5 原文运行的 agent。

> 一句话：**工具用 dsh standard 的，人格用 Claude 的。**

---

## 特性

- **人格逐字内联**：提示词全文进 `dsh-persona` 的 `prefix` 段（order 0），不截断、不改写。
- **人格分七段、可裁剪**：`prompt/` 下每段独立可编辑，`build.mjs` 按序拼接，`check.mjs`
  逐字节校验拼接结果；前六段的逐字原文同时放在 `preset/skills/.../reference/`，
  裁剪后随时取回。
- **工具面保持完整**：预设由 dsh 官方 `standard` 预设整目录派生，文件读写 / 检索 /
  pwsh / 后台任务 / Skills / 计划 / 目标 / 子代理 / 工作流 / web 工具全部保留。
- **一段运行环境适配**：`prompt/bridge.md` 把原文里提到的产品侧工具
  （`memory_read`、`conversation_search`、`search_mcp_registry`、`window.storage`、
  `end_conversation` …）收敛到本 harness 真实存在的工具，避免模型调用不存在的工具。
- **子代理不再背人格**：`tool-subagent`（provider `spawn`）行带一段 461 字符的子代理人格，
  新 spawn 的子代理不会复制 96 KB 人格（fork 行刻意保持继承父人格——它的意义就是继承历史
  并复用 KV cache）。
- **原文随预设自带**：预设内 `skills/claude-opus-5-5-provenance/`（由 `customSkillDirs`
  + `baseUrl` 挂载）把人格来源、重建/裁剪步骤与**逐字原文**放进一个按需加载的 skill，
  常驻 token 成本为 0。
- **可重建**：`scripts/build.mjs` 从 `base/` + `prompt/` 重新生成 composition，
  dsh 升级后一条命令即可跟上新 schema。

---

## 目录结构

```
.
├── package.json              # 同时是一个 dsh bundle 插件（dsh.bundle.patch）
├── cordis.patch.yml          # bundle patch：insert 一行 host 插件
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js              # host 插件：把 preset/ 同步进 $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/
│   └── persona.mjs           # 人格七段的单一来源：段列表、读取与拼接规则、变量注册表
├── preset/
│   ├── agent.cordis.yml      # 可直接安装的 composition（含内联人格，约 113 KB）
│   ├── preset.yml            # 显示名与描述
│   └── skills/
│       └── claude-opus-5-5-provenance/
│           ├── SKILL.md      # 预设自带的 skill：来源、重建/裁剪、升级坑
│           └── reference/Claude-Opus-5.5.md   # 人格逐字原文（裁剪后可对照取回）
├── base/
│   └── agent.cordis.yml      # 派生的上游基线（未打补丁的 dsh standard 预设，0.2.0-rc.2）
├── prompt/                   # 人格七段（第 7 段 bridge 是本仓库原创）
│   ├── opening.md  identity.md  agentic.md  environment.md
│   ├── memory.md   toolsyntax.md  bridge.md
├── scripts/
│   ├── build.mjs             # 由 base/ + prompt/ 生成 preset/agent.cordis.yml
│   ├── build-reference.mjs   # 由 prompt/ 生成 reference/Claude-Opus-5.5.md
│   ├── check.mjs             # 生成物自检（persona schema、row 完整、两处补丁、上游漂移）
│   ├── check-plugin.mjs      # bundle 插件自检：DSH_HOME 解析、安装、幂等、不删文件
│   ├── ci-check.sh           # 本地 CI：构建可复现校验 + 变量校验 + 自检
│   ├── extract.mjs           # 当初切分七段的一次性工具（溯源用）
│   ├── sync-base.mjs         # 从 --dump-config 捕获重新派生 base/（溯源用）
│   ├── install.ps1           # Windows 安装（方式 B）
│   └── install.sh            # macOS / Linux 安装（方式 B）
├── docs/
│   └── notes.md              # 原理、schema 迁移坑、升级维护说明
├── NOTICE.md                 # 提示词文本的来源与归属
└── LICENSE                   # MIT（仅覆盖脚本与配置）
```

---

## 安装

预设按 id 决定目录名，dsh 只会从 `${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/.agent-presets/<id>/` 读取本地预设。

### 方式 A：通过 dsh 安装（推荐，一条命令，自带更新）

本仓库同时是一个 **dsh bundle 插件**（`package.json` 里声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，
`cordis.patch.yml` 里 insert 一行 host 插件）。装上之后它会在每次启动时把仓库里
`preset/` 同步进预设目录，因此不需要手动复制：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Zioove/claude-opus-5-5-dsh-preset
# 然后重启 dsh web（bundle 层在下次启动时加载）
```

- 安装/升级：`dsh plugin --profile web add|update dsh-preset-claude-opus-5-5`
- 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-preset-claude-opus-5-5`
  （已落盘的预设目录会保留，需要时自己删 `<DSH_HOME>/.agent-presets/claude-opus-5-5/`）
- 该插件**零依赖**（只用 node 内置模块）、**幂等**（逐文件比字节，内容一样就不写）、
  **不会因为失败而拖垮启动**（出错只打日志）、**从不删除**已安装文件。
  它会覆盖同名的本地改动：仓库版本为准。
- 若 pnpm 提示需要 `allowBuilds`，那只会出现在带 `prepare`/`postinstall` 的包上，
  本包没有安装脚本，正常情况不需要授权。

### 方式 B：克隆后运行安装脚本

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Zioove/claude-opus-5-5-dsh-preset.git
cd claude-opus-5-5-dsh-preset
pwsh -File scripts/install.ps1        # Windows
```

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Zioove/claude-opus-5-5-dsh-preset.git
cd claude-opus-5-5-dsh-preset
bash scripts/install.sh               # macOS / Linux
```

### 方式 C：手动复制

把 `preset/` 复制到 `%DSH_HOME%\.agent-presets\claude-opus-5-5\`
（或 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/claude-opus-5-5/`）：

```
.agent-presets/claude-opus-5-5/agent.cordis.yml
.agent-presets/claude-opus-5-5/preset.yml
.agent-presets/claude-opus-5-5/skills/…
```

### 零拷贝（进阶）

`dsh-agent-presets` 的 row 支持 `roots` 配置（扫描顺序里靠前的 root 优先），
所以也可以把克隆下来的仓库直接挂成一个预设 root——把 `preset/` 重排成
`presets/claude-opus-5-5/agent.cordis.yml`，再在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`
或宿主配置里给 `agent-presets` row 加：

```yaml
- id: agent-presets
  config:
    roots:
      - path: ~/src/claude-opus-5-5-dsh-preset/presets
        trust: user
```

`path` 支持 `~`，相对路径按进程 cwd 解析，所以请用绝对路径或 `~`。
这样 `git pull` 就等于升级预设，代价是要手改配置。

---

## 验证与重建

```bash
node scripts/build.mjs           # 由 base/ + prompt/ 重建 preset/agent.cordis.yml
node scripts/build-reference.mjs # 由 prompt/ 重建 reference/Claude-Opus-5.5.md
node scripts/check.mjs           # 自检：persona schema、row 完整、两处补丁在位
node scripts/check-plugin.mjs    # bundle 插件自检：DSH_HOME、安装、幂等、不删文件
bash scripts/ci-check.sh         # 以上 + 构建可复现校验（本地 CI）
```

`preset/agent.cordis.yml` 与 `reference/Claude-Opus-5.5.md` 都是**生成物**：改人格文本或
同步 `base/` 之后必须重跑对应脚本并提交结果，否则 CI 会在 `git diff --exit-code` 上失败。

---

## 使用

1. 重开或刷新 dsh Web GUI，在会话的预设选择器里选 **Claude Opus 5.5**。
2. 想让它成为新会话的默认预设，在 `settings.yaml` 里写：

   ```yaml
   agent-presets:
     default: claude-opus-5-5
   ```

   （该值每次解析时读取，改完不需要重启 dsh。也可直接在 GUI 的预设选择器里切换。）

---

## 本预设相对 standard 的刻意改动

`build.mjs` 里有三个显式补丁，每处改动都写明了它覆盖的是上游哪个事实、为什么。
锚点在新版 `standard` 里找不到（或匹配多处）时构建会**报错退出**，不会静默丢掉改动：

| 改动 | 为什么 |
|---|---|
| `skill-filesystem` 加 `customSkillDirs`（`!!js` + `baseUrl` 指向 preset 自己的 `skills/`） | 让来源与原文随预设自带、按需加载；这是 shipped `cordis` 预设用的同一套机制 |
| `tool-subagent`（spawn）加 461 字符 `persona` | 人格是常驻成本，新 spawn 的子代理不需要 96 KB 版本；fork 不加，因为它要继承历史并复用父级 KV cache |
| 插入 `persona` row，`prefix` 为七段拼接 | 上游 `standard` 的 persona row 只是 `You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.` 一行 |

另外人格通过 `{{model}}` 引用当前模型名——**上游范式是「一个事实只有一个归属方」**：
模型名由 agent-loop 注册为提示词变量，人格只引用它、不硬写。dsh 的插值是严格的，
未注册的 `{{...}}` 会让整轮请求失败，所以 `ci-check.sh` 会拒绝生成含未注册变量的人格。

---

## 原理

dsh 的系统提示是**按段拼装**的，`dsh-persona` 这个 row 提供两个段：

| 段 | order | 本预设内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `deployment:persona-prefix` | 0 | Claude Opus 5.5 七段拼接 + 运行环境适配段 |
| `deployment:persona-suffix` | 10200 | `Your working directory is {{cwd}}.` |

harness 的固定身份段（-100）与工具使用指引段（100–199）依然由 `standard` 提供，
因此这个预设是「dsh 的骨架 + Claude 的人格」，而不是把 dsh 的提示整段替换掉。
若想让人格文本成为**唯一**系统提示（会一并去掉 harness 身份与工具指引），在
`preset/agent.cordis.yml` 的 persona row 里加 `complete: true`。

composition 里三条 `isolate` realm 规则（`planning` / `compaction` / `delegation`）
是 dsh 对「预设自有服务」的硬要求，本仓库原样保留，未做改动。

---

## 成本提示

人格段常驻系统提示，约 **95 KB ≈ 3 万 token**，每次请求都会带上。
上下文窗口足够（模型配置 1,000,000）时无碍，但会显著抬高单价成本。想瘦身：
编辑 `prompt/` 下对应段落只保留需要的章节，再 `node scripts/build.mjs`。

---

## 升级维护（重要）

dsh 会改 row 的 config schema。本仓库踩过的坑：

- **dsh ≤ 0.1.4**：`dsh-persona` 的字段是 `text: <string>`。
- **dsh 0.1.5-rc.3 起**：字段改为 `prefix`（必填）与 `suffix`；旧写法会以
  `invalid config: $.prefix missing required value` **挂载失败**。
  如果这个预设同时是默认预设，症状就是**新建对话直接失败、磁盘上不产生 session 目录**。

`base/` 对齐的是 **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2** 的 `standard` 预设。想知道它有没有过期，让
`check.mjs` 直接和线上预设比对：

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config > /tmp/dump.txt
DSH_DUMP=/tmp/dump.txt node scripts/check.mjs
```

它会报告 row 增删与 config 变化；没有捕获时只提示「未检查」，不算失败
（重新同步 `base/` 是需要判断的决定，不能自动化）。

升级 dsh 后请重新同步基线并重建：

```bash
# 1) 从线上预设重新派生 base/
dsh --profile web --dump-config > /tmp/dump.txt
node scripts/sync-base.mjs /tmp/dump.txt
# 2) 重建 + 自检
node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-reference.mjs
node scripts/check.mjs
DSH_DUMP=/tmp/dump.txt node scripts/check.mjs        # 确认漂移已清零
# 3) 安装/更新，并在 GUI 里新建一次会话确认
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-preset-claude-opus-5-5   # 方式 A（bundle）
#   或 bash scripts/install.sh / pwsh -File scripts/install.ps1 -Force
```

`sync-base.mjs` 从 dump 里取 `preset-standard` 的 plugins、去掉 persona row、
还原成列 0 的 composition；dump 不带注释，所以它会保留旧 `base/` 的注释块、
块内空行和 block scalar 的原始折行并贴回对应 row（对同一份 dump 逐字节可复现）。
想放弃这些保留，加 `--no-keep-comments` / `--no-keep-blocks`。

shipped 预设目录位置与预设 id 也会随版本变化（例如 0.1.5 起目录移到
`node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets/presets/`，预设 `code` 更名为 `ptc`）。
详见 `docs/notes.md`。

---

## 已知限制

- 原文提到的产品侧能力（记忆文件系统、历史对话检索、MCP 连接器目录、Artifacts 存储、
  Imagine、`end_conversation`）在 dsh 中不存在，已由适配段明确排除；需要跨会话记忆时
  使用本机记忆服务（OpenViking）的工具。
- 原文写的是 Anthropic 产品体系，本预设只把它当人格与行为准则使用，不改变模型路由、
  也不代表 Anthropic 或 DeepSeek 的任何官方立场。
- 人格文本一旦改动，系统提示前缀即变化，会重建 KV cache。
